verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִן־הָרָמָתַיִם צוֹפִים מֵהַר אֶפְרָיִם וּשְׁמוֹ אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־אֱלִיהוּא בֶּן־תֹּחוּ בֶן־צוּף אֶפְרָתִי׃
verses.english: Now there was a man from Ramatayim in Tzofim, from the highlands of Efrayim;his name was Elkana son of Yeroham son of Elihu son of Tohu son of Tzuf, an Efrayimite.

verses.hebrew: וְלוֹ שְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֵׁם אַחַת חַנָּה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית פְּנִנָּה וַיְהִי לִפְנִנָּה יְלָדִים וּלְחַנָּה אֵין יְלָדִים׃
verses.english: He had two wives:the name of one was Hanna trad. English “Hannah.” /Grace, while the name of the second was Peninna trad. English “Peninnah.”/Pearl;now Peninna had children, but Hanna had no children.

verses.hebrew: וְעָלָה הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מֵעִירוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת וְלִזְבֹּחַ לַיהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּשִׁלֹה וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי חָפְנִי וּפִנְחָס כֹּהֲנִים לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: And that man used to go up from his town, from year to year,to bow down and to sacrifice to YHWH”). YHWH of the Forces-On-High: In The Early Prophets this title has a military ring; tzeva’ot may also refer to the concept of a heavenly council of gods from earlier mythological traditions. of the Forces-On-High, at Shilo trad. English “Shiloh,” one of the important pre-Jerusalem shrines, situated in the highlands of Efrayim. —Eli’s two sons, Hofni and Pin’has and pin-HASS. Like a number of early Israelite priestly names, these are Egyptian in origin. Pin’has is trad. English “Phineas” and means “dark-skinned.”, priests to YHWH, were there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיִּזְבַּח אֶלְקָנָה וְנָתַן לִפְנִנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּלְכָל־בָּנֶיהָ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ מָנוֹת׃
verses.english: Now it was, one day,that Elkana was sacrificing,—he would give to Peninna his wife, and to all her sons and daughters, portions,

verses.hebrew: וּלְחַנָּה יִתֵּן מָנָה אַחַת אַפָּיִם כִּי אֶת־חַנָּה אָהֵב וַיהוָה סָגַר רַחְמָהּ׃
verses.english: but to Hanna he would give a double portion,for [it was] Hanna he loved,although YHWH had closed up her womb.

verses.hebrew: וְכִעֲסַתָּה צָרָתָהּ גַּם־כַּעַס בַּעֲבוּר הַרְּעִמָהּ כִּי־סָגַר יְהוָה בְּעַד רַחְמָהּ׃
verses.english: And her rival-wife would provoke her with provocation, for the sake of making-her-complain,for YHWH had closed up her womb;

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה מִדֵּי עֲלֹתָהּ בְּבֵית יְהוָה כֵּן תַּכְעִסֶנָּה וַתִּבְכֶּה וְלֹא תֹאכַל׃
verses.english: and thus he would do, year after year:whenever she would go up to the House of God, thus would she provoke her—… and she wept and would not eat,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ אֶלְקָנָה אִישָׁהּ חַנָּה לָמֶה תִבְכִּי וְלָמֶה לֹא תֹאכְלִי וְלָמֶה יֵרַע לְבָבֵךְ הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי טוֹב לָךְ מֵעֲשָׂרָה בָּנִים׃
verses.english: so Elkana her husband said to her:Hanna, why are you weeping?Why don’t you eat?And why is your heart in such ill-humor?Am I not better to you than ten sons?

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם חַנָּה אַחֲרֵי אָכְלָה בְשִׁלֹה וְאַחֲרֵי שָׁתֹה וְעֵלִי הַכֹּהֵן יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַכִּסֵּא עַל־מְזוּזַת הֵיכַל יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Hanna arose after eating at Shilo, and after drinking—now Eli the priest was sitting on a throne tends to mean more than a simple “chair” in the Bible. by the doorpost of the great-hall of YHWH—

verses.hebrew: וְהִיא מָרַת נָפֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל־יְהוָה וּבָכֹה תִבְכֶּה׃
verses.english: and she was bitter of feelings,so she prayed to YHWH, while she wept, yes, wept;

verses.hebrew: וַתִּדֹּר נֶדֶר וַתֹּאמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אִם־רָאֹה תִרְאֶה בָּעֳנִי אֲמָתֶךָ וּזְכַרְתַּנִי וְלֹא־תִשְׁכַּח אֶת־אֲמָתֶךָ וְנָתַתָּה לַאֲמָתְךָ זֶרַע אֲנָשִׁים וּנְתַתִּיו לַיהוָה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו וּמוֹרָה לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: she vowed a vow, and said:O YHWH of the Forces-On-High,if you will see, yes, see the affliction of your maidservant,and will bear me in mind and not forget your maidservant,and will give your maidservant seed of men,then I will give him to YHWH all the days of his life:no razor shall go up on his head!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי הִרְבְּתָה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְעֵלִי שֹׁמֵר אֶת־פִּיהָ׃
verses.english: Now it was, as she multiplied her praying in the presence of YHWH,that Eli was watching her mouth:

verses.hebrew: וְחַנָּה הִיא מְדַבֶּרֶת עַל־לִבָּהּ רַק שְׂפָתֶיהָ נָּעוֹת וְקוֹלָהּ לֹא יִשָּׁמֵעַ וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ עֵלִי לְשִׁכֹּרָה׃
verses.english: now Hanna, she was speaking in her heart,only her lips were moving, but her voice could not be heard—so Eli took her for a drunkard.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֵלִי עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִין הָסִירִי אֶת־יֵינֵךְ מֵעָלָיִךְ׃
verses.english: Eli said to her:How long will you be drunk?Put away your wine from you!

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַן חַנָּה וַתֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲדֹנִי אִשָּׁה קְשַׁת־רוּחַ אָנֹכִי וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר לֹא שָׁתִיתִי וָאֶשְׁפֹּךְ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: But Hanna answered and said:No, my lord,a woman hardened of spirit am I.Wine and beer I have not drunk,but I have been pouring out my soul which in the Bible does not mean the opposite of “body,” but here, the English has the connotation of “feelings.” in the presence of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן אֶת־אֲמָתְךָ לִפְנֵי בַּת־בְּלִיָּעַל כִּי־מֵרֹב שִׂיחִי וְכַעְסִי דִּבַּרְתִּי עַד־הֵנָּה׃
verses.english: Do not consider your maidservant a base woman,for it is out of my great anxiety and my being provoked [that] I have spoken until now.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם וֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן אֶת־שֵׁלָתֵךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתְּ מֵעִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: Eli answered and said: Go in peace,and may the God of Israel grant your request that you have requested of him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר תִּמְצָא שִׁפְחָתְךָ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָאִשָּׁה לְדַרְכָּהּ וַתֹּאכַל וּפָנֶיהָ לֹא־הָיוּ־לָהּ עוֹד׃
verses.english: She said:May your handmaid find favor in your eyes.The woman went on her way, and she ate,and her face was no longer [sad] on her.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּיתָם הָרָמָתָה וַיֵּדַע אֶלְקָנָה אֶת־חַנָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּזְכְּרֶהָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: They started-early in the morning:they bowed down in the presence of YHWH;then they returned, and came back to their house in Rama.And Elkana knew Hanna his wife,and YHWH kept her in mind.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִתְקֻפוֹת הַיָּמִים וַתַּהַר חַנָּה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁמוּאֵל כִּי מֵיְהוָה שְׁאִלְתִּיו׃
verses.english: So it was, at the turning of days,that Hanna conceived and gave birth to a son;she called his name: Shemuel trad. English “Samuel.” /The One From God,meaning: from YHWH I requested is really associated with the name of Sha’ul (Saul) (see v.28, where “lent-on-request” is vocalized sha’ul). him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הָאִישׁ אֶלְקָנָה וְכָל־בֵּיתוֹ לִזְבֹּחַ לַיהוָה אֶת־זֶבַח הַיָּמִים וְאֶת־נִדְרוֹ׃
verses.english: And the man Elkana went up, along with all his household,to sacrifice to YHWH the yearly sacrifice, and his vow-offering,

verses.hebrew: וְחַנָּה לֹא עָלָתָה כִּי־אָמְרָה לְאִישָׁהּ עַד יִגָּמֵל הַנַּעַר וַהֲבִאֹתִיו וְנִרְאָה אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה וְיָשַׁב שָׁם עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: but Hanna did not go up,for she said to her husband:… until the lad is weaned—then I will bring him,that he may be seen in the presence of YHWH;he is to stay there forever.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ אֶלְקָנָה אִישָׁהּ עֲשִׂי הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינַיִךְ שְׁבִי עַד־גָּמְלֵךְ אֹתוֹ אַךְ יָקֵם יְהוָה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ וַתֵּשֶׁב הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּינֶק אֶת־בְּנָהּ עַד־גָּמְלָהּ אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: Elkana her husband said to her:Do whatever is good in your eyes:stay until you have weaned him—only: may YHWH fulfill his word!So the woman stayed behind and nursed her son, until she had weaned him.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲלֵהוּ עִמָּהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר גְּמָלַתּוּ בְּפָרִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאֵיפָה אַחַת קֶמַח וְנֵבֶל יַיִן וַתְּבִאֵהוּ בֵית־יְהוָה שִׁלוֹ וְהַנַּעַר נָעַר׃
verses.english: She brought him up with her, when she had weaned him,with a three-year-old bull and an efa Pronounced ay-FAH. It was a dry measure, perhaps fifteen liters. of flour, and a skin of wine,and brought him to the House of YHWH at Shilo,though the lad was [just] a lad.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת־הַפָּר וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶל־עֵלִי׃
verses.english: They slaughtered the bull,and then they brought the lad to Eli.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי חֵי נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי הָאִשָּׁה הַנִּצֶּבֶת עִמְּכָה בָּזֶה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: She said:Please, my lord, as you yourself live, my lord:I am the woman who was standing beside you here, to pray to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַזֶּה הִתְפַּלָּלְתִּי וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לִי אֶת־שְׁאֵלָתִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵעִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: It was for this lad that I prayed,and YHWH has granted my request that I requested of him!

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אָנֹכִי הִשְׁאִלְתִּהוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה הוּא שָׁאוּל לַיהוָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ שָׁם לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: So I now lend-him-on-request can also mean “lend.” to YHWH;all the days that he lives he is lent-on-request/sha’ul to YHWH.And they bowed down there to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל חַנָּה וַתֹּאמַר עָלַץ לִבִּי בַּיהוָה רָמָה קַרְנִי בַּיהוָה רָחַב פִּי עַל־אוֹיְבַי כִּי שָׂמַחְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: And Hanna prayed, she said:My heart swells because of YHWH,my horn is raised because of YHWH;my mouth is wide-with-boasting over my enemies,for I rejoice in your deliverance!

verses.hebrew: אֵין־קָדוֹשׁ כַּיהוָה כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּךָ וְאֵין צוּר כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: There is no one holy like YHWH,indeed, no one beside you,there is no rock like our God!

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּרְבּוּ תְדַבְּרוּ גְּבֹהָה גְבֹהָה יֵצֵא עָתָק מִפִּיכֶם כִּי אֵל דֵּעוֹת יְהוָה ולא [וְלוֹ] נִתְכְּנוּ עֲלִלוֹת׃
verses.english: Do not speak so high, so high [and mighty],letting your mouth run free,for a god all-knowing is YHWH,by him are actions measured.

verses.hebrew: קֶשֶׁת גִּבֹּרִים חַתִּים וְנִכְשָׁלִים אָזְרוּ חָיִל׃
verses.english: The bow of the mighty is shattered,but the stumblers are girded with strength.

verses.hebrew: שְׂבֵעִים בַּלֶּחֶם נִשְׂכָּרוּ וּרְעֵבִים חָדֵלּוּ עַד־עֲקָרָה יָלְדָה שִׁבְעָה וְרַבַּת בָּנִים אֻמְלָלָה׃
verses.english: Those once-sated must hire themselves out for bread,but those once-hungry will endure forever.The barren one has given birth to seven,while the one [with] many sons is dried up.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה מוֹרִיד שְׁאוֹל וַיָּעַל׃
verses.english: YHWH brings-death and bestows-life,brings down to Sheol The biblical underworld. Unlike the later concepts of heaven and hell, it appears to be simply a subdued place where the dead rest (see Chap. 28 below), similar to the Greek Hades. and brings up.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מוֹרִישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁיר מַשְׁפִּיל אַף־מְרוֹמֵם׃
verses.english: YHWH makes-poor and makes-rich,brings low and, yes, lifts up.

verses.hebrew: מֵקִים מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב עִם־נְדִיבִים וְכִסֵּא כָבוֹד יַנְחִלֵם כִּי לַיהוָה מְצֻקֵי אֶרֶץ וַיָּשֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶם תֵּבֵל׃
verses.english: He raises the needy from the dust,lifts the destitute from the dunghill,to seat them with the noble ones,and a throne of glory he has them inherit.For YHWH’s are the molten-pillars of the earth,he has set the world upon them.

verses.hebrew: רַגְלֵי חסידו [חֲסִידָיו] יִשְׁמֹר וּרְשָׁעִים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יִדָּמּוּ כִּי־לֹא בְכֹחַ יִגְבַּר־אִישׁ׃
verses.english: The feet of his loyal ones he guards,but the wicked moan sometimes has this meaning, as opposed to the traditional “are silent.” in darkness—for not by might does a man prevail.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יֵחַתּוּ מריבו [מְרִיבָיו] עלו [עָלָיו] בַּשָּׁמַיִם יַרְעֵם יְהוָה יָדִין אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְיִתֶּן־עֹז לְמַלְכּוֹ וְיָרֵם קֶרֶן מְשִׁיחוֹ׃
verses.english: YHWH shatters those opposing him,from the heavens he thunders against them.YHWH judges to the limits of the earth;may he give power to his king,and lift up the horn of his anointed one!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶלְקָנָה הָרָמָתָה עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהַנַּעַר הָיָה מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי עֵלִי הַכֹּהֵן׃
verses.english: And Elkana went to Rama, to his house,while the lad began to attend YHWH, in the presence of Eli the priest.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עֵלִי בְּנֵי בְלִיָּעַל לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now the sons of Eli were base fellows as a devil figure, “Belial.” ;they did not know YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁפַּט הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־הָעָם כָּל־אִישׁ זֹבֵחַ זֶבַח וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן כְּבַשֵּׁל הַבָּשָׂר וְהַמַּזְלֵג שְׁלֹשׁ־הַשִּׁנַּיִם בְּיָדוֹ׃
verses.english: And the norm of the priests with the people [was]:whoever sacrificed a sacrifice,the priest’s serving-lad would come while the flesh was boilingwith a fork of three teeth in his hand

verses.hebrew: וְהִכָּה בַכִּיּוֹר אוֹ בַדּוּד אוֹ בַקַּלַּחַת אוֹ בַפָּרוּר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה הַמַּזְלֵג יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן בּוֹ כָּכָה יַעֲשׂוּ לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים שָׁם בְּשִׁלֹה׃
verses.english: and would strike at the pot or the kettle or the cauldron or the boiling-vat;everything the fork would bring up, the priest would take for himself.Thus they would do to all Israel who were coming there, at Shilo.

verses.hebrew: גַּם בְּטֶרֶם יַקְטִרוּן אֶת־הַחֵלֶב וּבָא נַעַר הַכֹּהֵן וְאָמַר לָאִישׁ הַזֹּבֵחַ תְּנָה בָשָׂר לִצְלוֹת לַכֹּהֵן וְלֹא־יִקַּח מִמְּךָ בָּשָׂר מְבֻשָּׁל כִּי אִם־חָי׃
verses.english: Even before they would turn the fat into smoke,the serving-lad of the priest would come and say to the person sacrificing:Give over some flesh for roasting, for the priest,for he will not take boiled flesh from you—only raw!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הָאִישׁ קַטֵּר יַקְטִירוּן כַּיּוֹם הַחֵלֶב וְקַח־לְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וְאָמַר לו [לֹא] כִּי עַתָּה תִתֵּן וְאִם־לֹא לָקַחְתִּי בְחָזְקָה׃
verses.english: And if the person said to him:Let them first turn the fat into smoke, yes, smoke,then take for yourself whatever your appetite craves—he would say to him:No, but give it over right-now;if not, I’ll take it by force!

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי חַטַּאת הַנְּעָרִים גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה כִּי נִאֲצוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים אֵת מִנְחַת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now the sin of the serving-lads was exceedingly great in the presence of YHWH,for the men scorned the gift [intended] for YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה נַעַר חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּד׃
verses.english: Shemuel was attending in the presence of YHWH,as a lad girded with a linen efod. Pronounced ay-FODE, an apron-like priestly garment which covered the torso, described in Exod. 28:6ff.

verses.hebrew: וּמְעִיל קָטֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ אִמּוֹ וְהַעַלְתָה לוֹ מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה בַּעֲלוֹתָהּ אֶת־אִישָׁהּ לִזְבֹּחַ אֶת־זֶבַח הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: Now a small cloak his mother used to make himand used to bring it up from year to year, when she went up with her husband to sacrifice the yearly sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וּבֵרַךְ עֵלִי אֶת־אֶלְקָנָה וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאָמַר יָשֵׂם יְהוָה לְךָ זֶרַע מִן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת תַּחַת הַשְּׁאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַל לַיהוָה וְהָלְכוּ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: And Eli would bless Elkana and his wife;he would say:May YHWH give you seed from this womanin place of the requested-one who was lent-on-request to YHWH!Then they would go back to their place.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־פָקַד יְהוָה אֶת־חַנָּה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד שְׁלֹשָׁה־בָנִים וּשְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל עִם־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Indeed, YHWH took account of Hanna,and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters;but the lad Shemuel grew up in the presence of in 4QS and LXX, in place of MT’s ’im, “with.” YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְעֵלִי זָקֵן מְאֹד וְשָׁמַע אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשׂוּן בָּנָיו לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכְּבוּן אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים הַצֹּבְאוֹת פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃
verses.english: Now when Eli became exceedingly old,he heard about all that his sons were doing to all Israel:how they were lying with the women who were acting-as-a-workforce at the entrance to the Tent of Appointment.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לָמָּה תַעֲשׂוּן כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ אֶת־דִּבְרֵיכֶם רָעִים מֵאֵת כָּל־הָעָם אֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: He said to them:Why do you act in accordance with these words that I hear—evil accounts of you from all of these people?

verses.hebrew: אַל בָּנָי כִּי לוֹא־טוֹבָה הַשְּׁמֻעָה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁמֵעַ מַעֲבִרִים עַם־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Don’t, my sons!Indeed, it is no good, the report that I hear YHWH’s people spreading.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יֶחֱטָא אִישׁ לְאִישׁ וּפִלְלוֹ אֱלֹהִים וְאִם לַיהוָה יֶחֱטָא־אִישׁ מִי יִתְפַּלֶּל־לוֹ וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ לְקוֹל אֲבִיהֶם כִּי־חָפֵץ יְהוָה לַהֲמִיתָם׃
verses.english: If a man sins against [another] man, God will mediate for him,but if it is against YHWH [that] a man sins, who will intercede for him?Yet they did not hearken to their father’s voice,for YHWH desired to have them die.

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל הֹלֵךְ וְגָדֵל וָטוֹב גַּם עִם־יְהוָה וְגַם עִם־אֲנָשִׁים׃
verses.english: But the lad Shemuel went on growing greater and more pleasing,so with YHWH, so with men.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הֲנִגְלֹה נִגְלֵיתִי אֶל־בֵּית אָבִיךָ בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּמִצְרַיִם לְבֵית פַּרְעֹה׃
verses.english: A man of God came to Eli and said to him:Thus says YHWH:Did I not reveal, yes, reveal myself to your Father’s House when they were in Egypt, [belonging] to Pharaoh’s house,

verses.hebrew: וּבָחֹר אֹתוֹ מִכָּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִי לְכֹהֵן לַעֲלוֹת עַל־מִזְבְּחִי לְהַקְטִיר קְטֹרֶת לָשֵׂאת אֵפוֹד לְפָנָי וָאֶתְּנָה לְבֵית אָבִיךָ אֶת־כָּל־אִשֵּׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and choose it from all the tribes of Israel for myself, to act-as- priests—to ascend upon my sacrificial-altar, to send up smoking-incense, to wear the efod in my presence?And I gave to your Father’s House all the fire-offerings of the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תִבְעֲטוּ בְּזִבְחִי וּבְמִנְחָתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי מָעוֹן וַתְּכַבֵּד אֶת־בָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי לְהַבְרִיאֲכֶם מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּל־מִנְחַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַמִּי׃
verses.english: Why have you kicked away (“habitation,” here and v.32), which, following others, I have emended to ’ayin, “eye.” my sacrifices and my cereal-gifts that I commanded, with a grudging-eye?And you have honored your sons more than me,by letting them grow fat from the premier-part of all the gifts of Israel, in my presence!

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן נְאֻם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר אָמַרְתִּי בֵּיתְךָ וּבֵית אָבִיךָ יִתְהַלְּכוּ לְפָנַי עַד־עוֹלָם וְעַתָּה נְאֻם־יְהוָה חָלִילָה לִּי כִּי־מְכַבְּדַי אֲכַבֵּד וּבֹזַי יֵקָלּוּ׃
verses.english: Therefore,the Utterance of YHWH, God of Israel:I had said, yes, said:Your house and your Father’s House will walk in my presence for the ages;but now, the Utterance of YHWH:[Heaven] forbid for me!For those who honor me, I honor,but those who despise me will be cursed!

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְגָדַעְתִּי אֶת־זְרֹעֲךָ וְאֶת־זְרֹעַ בֵּית אָבִיךָ מִהְיוֹת זָקֵן בְּבֵיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Here, the days are comingwhen I will hew off your arm and the arm of your Father’s House,so that [no man] will grow old in your house;

verses.hebrew: וְהִבַּטְתָּ צַר מָעוֹן בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵיטִיב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה זָקֵן בְּבֵיתְךָ כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: you will look with a grudging-eye on all his doing-good for Israel,and there will be no elder in your house, all the days [to come].

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ לֹא־אַכְרִית לְךָ מֵעִם מִזְבְּחִי לְכַלּוֹת אֶת־עֵינֶיךָ וְלַאֲדִיב אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וְכָל־מַרְבִּית בֵּיתְךָ יָמוּתוּ אֲנָשִׁים׃
verses.english: Yet I will not cut off everyone belonging to you from my sacrifices,[but] to consume your eyes and exhaust your breath,in all of the greater-part of your house, men will die.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא אֶל־שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ אֶל־חָפְנִי וּפִינְחָס בְּיוֹם אֶחָד יָמוּתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And this is the sign for you that it will come-to-pass for your two sons, for Hofni and Pin’has:on a single day the two of them will die!

verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִימֹתִי לִי כֹּהֵן נֶאֱמָן כַּאֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי וּבְנַפְשִׁי יַעֲשֶׂה וּבָנִיתִי לוֹ בַּיִת נֶאֱמָן וְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי־מְשִׁיחִי כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: But I will establish for myself a trusted priestwho will do [what is] in my heart and in my being;I will build him a trustworthy household,and he will walk in the presence of my anointed one all the days [to come].

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כָּל־הַנּוֹתָר בְּבֵיתְךָ יָבוֹא לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ לַאֲגוֹרַת כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר־לָחֶם וְאָמַר סְפָחֵנִי נָא אֶל־אַחַת הַכְּהֻנּוֹת לֶאֱכֹל פַּת־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: And it will bethat whoever is left in your house—he will come to bow low to himfor payment of silver and a round-loaf of bread;he will say:Pray appoint me to one of the priestly-offices,[for me] to eat a bit of bread!

verses.hebrew: וְהַנַּעַר שְׁמוּאֵל מְשָׁרֵת אֶת־יְהוָה לִפְנֵי עֵלִי וּדְבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה יָקָר בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֵין חָזוֹן נִפְרָץ׃
verses.english: The lad Shemuel was attending YHWH in the presence of Eli.Now the word of YHWH was precious in those days;visions were not widespread.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְעֵלִי שֹׁכֵב בִּמְקֹמוֹ ועינו [וְעֵינָיו] הֵחֵלּוּ כֵהוֹת לֹא יוּכַל לִרְאוֹת׃
verses.english: It was on that daythat Eli was lying down in his place—his eyes had begun to dim, [so that] he was not able to see—

verses.hebrew: וְנֵר אֱלֹהִים טֶרֶם יִכְבֶּה וּשְׁמוּאֵל שֹׁכֵב בְּהֵיכַל יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: and the lamp of God had not yet gone out,while Shemuel was lying down in the great-hall of YHWH, where the Coffer of God was.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃
verses.english: And YHWH called to Shemuel.He said:Here I am.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרָץ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי־קָרָאתָ לִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־קָרָאתִי שׁוּב שְׁכָב וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּב׃
verses.english: And he ran to Eliand said:Here I am, for you called me!But he said:I did not call;return, lie down.He went and lay down.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה קְרֹא עוֹד שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּקָם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי קָרָאתָ לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־קָרָאתִי בְנִי שׁוּב שְׁכָב׃
verses.english: But YHWH called yet again: Shemuel!,and Shemuel arose and went to Eli,and said:Here I am, for you called me!But he said:I did not call, my son!Return, lie down.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל טֶרֶם יָדַע אֶת־יְהוָה וְטֶרֶם יִגָּלֶה אֵלָיו דְּבַר־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now Shemuel did not yet know YHWH;not yet had the word of YHWH been revealed to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה קְרֹא־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּשְּׁלִשִׁית וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי כִּי קָרָאתָ לִי וַיָּבֶן עֵלִי כִּי יְהוָה קֹרֵא לַנָּעַר׃
verses.english: And YHWH called again: Shemuel! a third time,and he arose and went to Eli,and said:Here I am, for you called me!Then Eli understoodthat YHWH was calling the lad.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵלִי לִשְׁמוּאֵל לֵךְ שְׁכָב וְהָיָה אִם־יִקְרָא אֵלֶיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ דַּבֵּר יְהוָה כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵל וַיִּשְׁכַּב בִּמְקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: Eli said to Shemuel:Go, lie down,and it shall be, if he calls you, you are to say:Speak, O YHWH, for your servant hearkens!So Shemuel went and lay down in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְהוָה וַיִּתְיַצַּב וַיִּקְרָא כְפַעַם־בְּפַעַם שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל דַּבֵּר כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: And YHWH came and stood [there]and called as time and time [before]: Shemuel! Shemuel!Shemuel said: Speak, for your servant hearkens!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עֹשֶׂה דָבָר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר כָּל־שֹׁמְעוֹ תְּצִלֶּינָה שְׁתֵּי אָזְנָיו׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Shemuel:Here, I am about to do a thing in Israelsuch that everyone who hears of it—their two ears will ring!

verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָקִים אֶל־עֵלִי אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ הָחֵל וְכַלֵּה׃
verses.english: On that day, I will fulfill upon Eli all that I spoke concerning his house,from beginning to end!

verses.hebrew: וְהִגַּדְתִּי לוֹ כִּי־שֹׁפֵט אֲנִי אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם בַּעֲוֺן אֲשֶׁר־יָדַע כִּי־מְקַלְלִים לָהֶם בָּנָיו וְלֹא כִהָה בָּם׃
verses.english: I have told himthat I am passing judgment on his house, for the ages,for the iniquity about which he has known,because his sons were treating God as opposed to ’lhym). lightly, yet he did not condemn them.

verses.hebrew: וְלָכֵן נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְבֵית עֵלִי אִם־יִתְכַּפֵּר עֲוֺן בֵּית־עֵלִי בְּזֶבַח וּבְמִנְחָה עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Therefore I swear concerning the house of Eli:Should be purged away. the iniquity of the house of Eli be purged awaythrough sacrifices or grain-gifts, for the ages … !

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שְׁמוּאֵל עַד־הַבֹּקֶר וַיִּפְתַּח אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה וּשְׁמוּאֵל יָרֵא מֵהַגִּיד אֶת־הַמַּרְאָה אֶל־עֵלִי׃
verses.english: Shemuel lay down until daybreak,and he opened the doors of the House of YHWH,but Shemuel was afraid of reporting the seen-vision to Eli.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא עֵלִי אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Eli called Shemuel;he said:Shemuel, my son!He said:Here I am.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ אַל־נָא תְכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף אִם־תְּכַחֵד מִמֶּנִּי דָּבָר מִכָּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: He said:What is the word that he spoke to you?Now do not conceal it from me …Thus may God do to you and thus may he add,if you conceal from me any wordfrom all the word[s] that he spoke to you!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים וְלֹא כִחֵד מִמֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה הוּא הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָו יַעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: So Shemuel reported to him all the words, and he did not conceal [anything] from him.And he said:He is YHWH;whatever is good in his eyes, may he do!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיהוָה הָיָה עִמּוֹ וְלֹא־הִפִּיל מִכָּל־דְּבָרָיו אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: Shemuel grew up, and YHWH was with him;he did not let any of his words fall to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כִּי נֶאֱמָן שְׁמוּאֵל לְנָבִיא לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: So all Israel knew, from Dan to Be’er-Sheva,that Shemuel was trustworthy as a prophet to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה לְהֵרָאֹה בְשִׁלֹה כִּי־נִגְלָה יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל בְּשִׁלוֹ בִּדְבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And YHWH was seen again at Shilo,for YHWH had revealed himself to Shemuel at Shilo, in accord with the word of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־שְׁמוּאֵל לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל לִקְרַאת פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־הָאֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר וּפְלִשְׁתִּים חָנוּ בַאֲפֵק׃
verses.english: And the word of Shemuel came-to-pass for all Israel.…And all Israel went out to meet the Philistines for battle;they encamped at Even Ha-Ezer/The Stone of Help,while the Philistines encamped at Afek.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַרְכוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּטֹּשׁ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּ בַמַּעֲרָכָה בַּשָּׂדֶה כְּאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃
verses.english: The Philistines arrayed-ranks to meet Israel,and the battle was spread out, so that Israel was defeated before the Philistines—they struck them in ranks in the open-field: about four thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה נְגָפָנוּ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נִקְחָה אֵלֵינוּ מִשִּׁלֹה אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה וְיָבֹא בְקִרְבֵּנוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵנוּ מִכַּף אֹיְבֵינוּ׃
verses.english: The people came back to the camp, and the elders of Israel said:Why has YHWH defeated us today before the Philistines?Let us take ourselves, from Shilo, the Coffer of YHWH’s Covenant,that he may come into our midstand deliver us from the grasp of our enemies!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הָעָם שִׁלֹה וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים וְשָׁם שְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי עִם־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים חָפְנִי וּפִינְחָס׃
verses.english: So the people sent to Shilo,and carried from there the Coffer of the Covenant of YHWH of the Forces-On-High, [The One] Seated on the Winged-Sphinxes), mythical guardians of ancient Near Eastern palaces and temples, should not be confused with the later image of “cherubim,” the naked, chubby little angels of Western art.—Eli’s two sons were there with the Coffer of the Covenant of God, Hofni and Pin’has.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִעוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וַתֵּהֹם הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And it waswhen the Coffer of the Covenant of YHWH came into the campthat all Israel shouted with a great shout,so that the land was in panic.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־קוֹל הַתְּרוּעָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֶה קוֹל הַתְּרוּעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת בְּמַחֲנֵה הָעִבְרִים וַיֵּדְעוּ כִּי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בָּא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: The Philistines heard the sound of the shoutingand said:What is this great sound of shouting in the Hebrews’ camp?Then they knewthat the Coffer of YHWH had come into the camp.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי אָמְרוּ בָּא אֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה כָּזֹאת אֶתְמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם׃
verses.english: And the Philistines were afraid,for they said [to themselves]:A god has come into the camp!And they said:Woe to us,for it was not like this yesterday [and] the day-before,

verses.hebrew: אוֹי לָנוּ מִי יַצִּילֵנוּ מִיַּד הָאֱלֹהִים הָאַדִּירִים הָאֵלֶּה אֵלֶּה הֵם הָאֱלֹהִים הַמַּכִּים אֶת־מִצְרַיִם בְּכָל־מַכָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: woe to us—who will rescue us from the hand of this mighty god?This is the god who struck down Egypt with every kind of blow in the wilderness!

verses.hebrew: הִתְחַזְּקוּ וִהְיוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן תַּעַבְדוּ לָעִבְרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבְדוּ לָכֶם וִהְיִיתֶם לַאֲנָשִׁים וְנִלְחַמְתֶּם׃
verses.english: Strengthen yourselves and be men, O Philistines,lest you have to serve the Hebrews, as they have served you!Be men and wage battle!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּנָּגֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וַתְּהִי הַמַּכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּפֹּל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי׃
verses.english: So the Philistines waged battle,and Israel was defeated, so that they fled, each to his tent.The striking-down was exceedingly great:there fell from Israel thirty thousand foot-soldiers.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲרוֹן אֱלֹהִים נִלְקָח וּשְׁנֵי בְנֵי־עֵלִי מֵתוּ חָפְנִי וּפִינְחָס׃
verses.english: Moreover the Coffer of God was taken,and Eli’s two sons died, Hofni and Pin’has.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרָץ אִישׁ־בִּנְיָמִן מֵהַמַּעֲרָכָה וַיָּבֹא שִׁלֹה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמַדָּיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: A Binyaminite man ran from the ranks;he came to Shilo on that same daywith his garb torn and earth on his head.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא וְהִנֵּה עֵלִי יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַכִּסֵּא יך [יַד] דֶּרֶךְ מְצַפֶּה כִּי־הָיָה לִבּוֹ חָרֵד עַל אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְהָאִישׁ בָּא לְהַגִּיד בָּעִיר וַתִּזְעַק כָּל־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: He came, and here: Eli was sitting on a throne, beside the road, waiting-anxiously,for his heart was trembling for the Coffer of God.And when the man came to tell it in the town,the whole town cried out;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע עֵלִי אֶת־קוֹל הַצְּעָקָה וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה קוֹל הֶהָמוֹן הַזֶּה וְהָאִישׁ מִהַר וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְעֵלִי׃
verses.english: Eli heard the sound of the outcryand said:What is this sound of panic?The man quickly came and told it to Eli,

verses.hebrew: וְעֵלִי בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה וְעֵינָיו קָמָה וְלֹא יָכוֹל לִרְאוֹת׃
verses.english: —Now Eli was ninety-eight years old;his eyes were set so that he could not see—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֶל־עֵלִי אָנֹכִי הַבָּא מִן־הַמַּעֲרָכָה וַאֲנִי מִן־הַמַּעֲרָכָה נַסְתִּי הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר בְּנִי׃
verses.english: the man said to Eli:I am the one who comes from the ranks,I myself—from the ranks I fled today!He said:How did the matter go, my son?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמְבַשֵּׂר וַיֹּאמֶר נָס יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְגַם מַגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה הָיְתָה בָעָם וְגַם־שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ מֵתוּ חָפְנִי וּפִינְחָס וַאֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים נִלְקָחָה׃
verses.english: The newsbringer answered;he said:Israel has fled before the Philistines,and also there has been a great defeat of the people,and also your two sons died, Hofni and Pin’has,and the Coffer of God has been taken!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּהַזְכִּירוֹ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל־הַכִּסֵּא אֲחֹרַנִּית בְּעַד יַד הַשַּׁעַר וַתִּשָּׁבֵר מַפְרַקְתּוֹ וַיָּמֹת כִּי־זָקֵן הָאִישׁ וְכָבֵד וְהוּא שָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: Now it was,at his making mention of the Coffer of God,that he fell from on the throne backward, alongside the gate,and his neck was broken, so that he died,for he was an old man, and heavy, punning with the important term kavod (“glory”) used both earlier (2:30) and later in the narrative (Auld 2011). .He had led Israel as judge for forty years.

verses.hebrew: וְכַלָּתוֹ אֵשֶׁת־פִּינְחָס הָרָה לָלַת וַתִּשְׁמַע אֶת־הַשְּׁמֻעָה אֶל־הִלָּקַח אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וּמֵת חָמִיהָ וְאִישָׁהּ וַתִּכְרַע וַתֵּלֶד כִּי־נֶהֶפְכוּ עָלֶיהָ צִרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Now his daughter-in-law, the wife of Pin’has, was pregnant, about to give birth,and when she heard the heard-report of the taking of the Coffer of Godand of the death of her father-in-law and her husband,she crouched and gave birth,for her labor-pains had turned [suddenly] upon her.

verses.hebrew: וּכְעֵת מוּתָהּ וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה הַנִּצָּבוֹת עָלֶיהָ אַל־תִּירְאִי כִּי בֵן יָלָדְתְּ וְלֹא עָנְתָה וְלֹא־שָׁתָה לִבָּהּ׃
verses.english: At the time of her dying, those [women] standing over her spoke:Do not be afraid, for you have given birth to a son! But she did not answer, nor did she pay any mind,

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא לַנַּעַר אִי־כָבוֹד לֵאמֹר גָּלָה כָבוֹד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הִלָּקַח אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְאֶל־חָמִיהָ וְאִישָׁהּ׃
verses.english: but she called the lad I-Khavod/Where-is-Glory, saying:Exiled is the glory from Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר גָּלָה כָבוֹד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נִלְקַח אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: She said:Exiled is the glory from Israel,for taken is the Coffer of God!

verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים לָקְחוּ אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיְבִאֻהוּ מֵאֶבֶן הָעֵזֶר אַשְׁדּוֹדָה׃
verses.english: Now when the Philistines took the Coffer of God,they brought it from Even Ha-Ezer to Ashdod.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ בֵּית דָּגוֹן וַיַּצִּיגוּ אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל דָּגוֹן׃
verses.english: Then the Philistines took the Coffer of Godand brought it to the House of Dagon a long-revered fertility god of the ancient Near East, here connected with the Philistines. While no material evidence of his worship among them has been found, the Philistines are known to have adapted quickly to local cultures.,and set it next to Dagon.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ אַשְׁדּוֹדִים מִמָּחֳרָת וְהִנֵּה דָגוֹן נֹפֵל לְפָנָיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־דָּגוֹן וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: The Ashdodites started-early on the morrow,but here was Dagon, fallen down on his face to the ground before the Coffer of YHWH!So they took Dagon and returned him to his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר מִמָּחֳרָת וְהִנֵּה דָגוֹן נֹפֵל לְפָנָיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וְרֹאשׁ דָּגוֹן וּשְׁתֵּי כַּפּוֹת יָדָיו כְּרֻתוֹת אֶל־הַמִּפְתָּן רַק דָּגוֹן נִשְׁאַר עָלָיו׃
verses.english: They started-early at daybreak, on the morrow,but here was Dagon, fallen down on his face to the ground before the Coffer of YHWH,with Dagon’s head and the two palms of his hands cut off, on the threshold;only Dagon[’s torso] remained on him.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יִדְרְכוּ כֹהֲנֵי דָגוֹן וְכָל־הַבָּאִים בֵּית־דָּגוֹן עַל־מִפְתַּן דָּגוֹן בְּאַשְׁדּוֹד עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: —Therefore the priests of Dagon and all who enter the House of Dagon do not tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod,until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְבַּד יַד־יְהוָה אֶל־הָאַשְׁדּוֹדִים וַיְשִׁמֵּם וַיַּךְ אֹתָם בעפלים [בַּטְּחֹרִים] אֶת־אַשְׁדּוֹד וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And the hand of YHWH was heavy against the Ashdodites, and he devastated to h-m-m, “panicked,” a key word in Chaps. them;he struck them with tumors,); scribal tradition has substituted the present “tumors” (’ofalim). These, and the mice-related plague (see 6:4), are viewed as a further divine curse on the Philistines for their possession of the Coffer. See Alter (1999) for a discussion of the long-standing confusion in the text; he cites an old interpretation that the passage actually refers to the bubonic plague.Ashdod and its territories.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־אַשְׁדּוֹד כִּי־כֵן וְאָמְרוּ לֹא־יֵשֵׁב אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמָּנוּ כִּי־קָשְׁתָה יָדוֹ עָלֵינוּ וְעַל דָּגוֹן אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: The men of Ashdod saw that [it was] thus,so they said:The Coffer of the God of Israel must not stay with us,for his hand is hard upon us and upon Dagon our god!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־כָּל־סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים אֲלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַאֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ גַּת יִסֹּב אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּסֵּבּוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So they sent and gathered together all the Philistine overlords to themand said:What shall we do with the Coffer of the God of Israel?They said:To Gat let the Coffer of the God of Israel be removed!So they had the Coffer of the God of Israel removed [there].

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הֵסַבּוּ אֹתוֹ וַתְּהִי יַד־יְהוָה בָּעִיר מְהוּמָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיַּךְ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וַיִּשָּׂתְרוּ לָהֶם עפלים [טְחֹרִים׃]
verses.english: But it was, after their removing it,that the hand of YHWH was against the town, [causing] an exceedingly great panic;he struck the men of the town, from small to great,and tumors broke out on them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים עֶקְרוֹן וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים עֶקְרוֹן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ הָעֶקְרֹנִים לֵאמֹר הֵסַבּוּ אֵלַי אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַהֲמִיתֵנִי וְאֶת־עַמִּי׃
verses.english: So they sent off the Coffer of God to Ekron,but when the Coffer of God entered Ekron,the Ekronites cried out, saying:They have removed to us the Coffer of the God of Israel,to cause our death and our people’s!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־כָּל־סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ שַׁלְּחוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיָשֹׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְלֹא־יָמִית אֹתִי וְאֶת־עַמִּי כִּי־הָיְתָה מְהוּמַת־מָוֶת בְּכָל־הָעִיר כָּבְדָה מְאֹד יַד הָאֱלֹהִים שָׁם׃
verses.english: So they sent and gathered all the Philistine overlords related to the English word “tyrants” through Greek.and said:Send away the Coffer of the God of Israel, that it may return to its place,so that it does not cause our death and our people’s!For there was a death panic all throughout the town;exceedingly heavy was the hand of God there.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־מֵתוּ הֻכּוּ בעפלים [בַּטְּחֹרִים] וַתַּעַל שַׁוְעַת הָעִיר הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: Now the men who did not die were struck with tumors,and the town’s cry-for-help went up to the heavens.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אֲרוֹן־יְהוָה בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃
verses.english: Now the Coffer of YHWH was in the territory of the Philistines for seven months;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַקֹּסְמִים לֵאמֹר מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַאֲרוֹן יְהוָה הוֹדִעֻנוּ בַּמֶּה נְשַׁלְּחֶנּוּ לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: then the Philistines called for the priests and for the diviners, saying:What are we to do with the Coffer of YHWH?Let us know how we can send it back to its place!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִם־מְשַׁלְּחִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַל־תְּשַׁלְּחוּ אֹתוֹ רֵיקָם כִּי־הָשֵׁב תָּשִׁיבוּ לוֹ אָשָׁם אָז תֵּרָפְאוּ וְנוֹדַע לָכֶם לָמָּה לֹא־תָסוּר יָדוֹ מִכֶּם׃
verses.english: They said:If you wish to send back the Coffer of the God of Israel, do not send it back empty,rather, make restitution, yes, restitution to him with a reparation-offering; a biblical sacrifice, explained in Lev. 5 as financial restitution for wrong-doing, including unintentional actions.then you will be healedand it will be made known to you why his hand has not turned aside from you.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָה הָאָשָׁם אֲשֶׁר נָשִׁיב לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ מִסְפַּר סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים חֲמִשָּׁה עפלי [טְחֹרֵי] זָהָב וַחֲמִשָּׁה עַכְבְּרֵי זָהָב כִּי־מַגֵּפָה אַחַת לְכֻלָּם וּלְסַרְנֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: They said:What is the reparation-offering with which we are to make restitution to him?They said:[By] the number of Philistine overlords:five gold tumors and five gold mice,for one plague was upon all [of you] and upon your overlords.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם צַלְמֵי עפליכם [טְחֹרֵיכֶם] וְצַלְמֵי עַכְבְּרֵיכֶם הַמַּשְׁחִיתִם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּנְתַתֶּם לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּבוֹד אוּלַי יָקֵל אֶת־יָדוֹ מֵעֲלֵיכֶם וּמֵעַל אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּמֵעַל אַרְצְכֶם׃
verses.english: You are to make images of your tumors and images of your mice that are bringing the land to ruin,and you are to give honor to the God of Israel;perhaps he will lighten his hand from upon you,from upon your gods and from upon your land.

verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה תְכַבְּדוּ אֶת־לְבַבְכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּבְּדוּ מִצְרַיִם וּפַרְעֹה אֶת־לִבָּם הֲלוֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר הִתְעַלֵּל בָּהֶם וַיְשַׁלְּחוּם וַיֵּלֵכוּ׃
verses.english: Why do you make your heart heavy-with-stubbornness,as Egypt and Pharaoh made their heart heavy-with-stubbornness?Was it not when he dealt wantonly with them that he sent them free and they went away?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ וַעֲשׂוּ עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה אֶחָת וּשְׁתֵּי פָרוֹת עָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה עֲלֵיהֶם עֹל וַאֲסַרְתֶּם אֶת־הַפָּרוֹת בָּעֲגָלָה וַהֲשֵׁיבֹתֶם בְּנֵיהֶם מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם הַבָּיְתָה׃
verses.english: So-now,fetch and make ready a new wagon and two milch cows that have not yet yielded to a yoke highlights the importance of the idea: animals in the Israelite cultic system (see Num. 19:2) must be perfect, untainted by secular use (exactly like the wagon above).;you are to bind the cows to the wagon,but you are to turn back their young behind them, indoors.

verses.hebrew: וּלְקַחְתֶּם אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וּנְתַתֶּם אֹתוֹ אֶל־הָעֲגָלָה וְאֵת כְּלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הֲשֵׁבֹתֶם לוֹ אָשָׁם תָּשִׂימוּ בָאַרְגַּז מִצִּדּוֹ וְשִׁלַּחְתֶּם אֹתוֹ וְהָלָךְ׃
verses.english: Then you are to take the Coffer of YHWHand are to put it on the wagon,and the gold objects with which you are making restitution to him as a reparation-offeringyou are to place in a pouch, to its side;then you are to send it off, that it may go.

verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתֶם אִם־דֶּרֶךְ גְּבוּלוֹ יַעֲלֶה בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ הוּא עָשָׂה לָנוּ אֶת־הָרָעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְאִם־לֹא וְיָדַעְנוּ כִּי לֹא יָדוֹ נָגְעָה בָּנוּ מִקְרֶה הוּא הָיָה לָנוּ׃
verses.english: And look [well]:if it goes up by way of its own territory, to Bet-Shemesh,then he did us this great evil;but if not,we will know that his hand did not touch us—an accident happened to us.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים כֵּן וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁתֵּי פָרוֹת עָלוֹת וַיַּאַסְרוּם בָּעֲגָלָה וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם כָּלוּ בַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: The men did thus:they got two milk-yielding cows and bound them to the wagon,but their young they shut up indoors.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה אֶל־הָעֲגָלָה וְאֵת הָאַרְגַּז וְאֵת עַכְבְּרֵי הַזָּהָב וְאֵת צַלְמֵי טְחֹרֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And they placed the Coffer of YHWH on the wagon,along with the chest and the gold mice and the images of their tumors.

verses.hebrew: וַיִשַּׁרְנָה הַפָּרוֹת בַּדֶּרֶךְ עַל־דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ בִּמְסִלָּה אַחַת הָלְכוּ הָלֹךְ וְגָעוֹ וְלֹא־סָרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֹלְכִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם עַד־גְּבוּל בֵּית שָׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: And the cows went-straight on the road, on the road to Bet- Shemesh:on one path they went, going along [and] lowing,but they did not turn right or left,while the Philistine overlords were walking behind them, as far as the territory of Bet-Shemesh.

verses.hebrew: וּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ קֹצְרִים קְצִיר־חִטִּים בָּעֵמֶק וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרוֹן וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ לִרְאוֹת׃
verses.english: Now Bet-Shemesh were harvesting the wheat harvest in the valley,and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the Coffer,and they rejoiced seeing it.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעֲגָלָה בָּאָה אֶל־שְׂדֵה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֵּית־הַשִּׁמְשִׁי וַתַּעֲמֹד שָׁם וְשָׁם אֶבֶן גְּדוֹלָה וַיְבַקְּעוּ אֶת־עֲצֵי הָעֲגָלָה וְאֶת־הַפָּרוֹת הֶעֱלוּ עֹלָה לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: When the wagon came to the field of Yehoshua the Bet-Shimshite, and came to a stop there—there was a great stone there—they split the wood of the wagon,while the cows they offered up as an offering-up to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם הוֹרִידוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וְאֶת־הָאַרְגַּז אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ כְלֵי־זָהָב וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶל־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה וְאַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ הֶעֱלוּ עֹלוֹת וַיִּזְבְּחוּ זְבָחִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: Now the Levites had brought down the Coffer of YHWHand the pouch that was with it, in which the gold objects were,and had put them on the great stone,while the men of Bet-Shemesh had offered-up offerings-upand sacrificed sacrifices on that day to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשָּׁה סַרְנֵי־פְלִשְׁתִּים רָאוּ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ עֶקְרוֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃
verses.english: When the five Philistine overlords saw [it],they returned to Ekron on that day.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה טְחֹרֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אָשָׁם לַיהוָה לְאַשְׁדּוֹד אֶחָד לְעַזָּה אֶחָד לְאַשְׁקְלוֹן אֶחָד לְגַת אֶחָד לְעֶקְרוֹן אֶחָד׃
verses.english: And these are the gold tumors with which the Philistines made restitution as a reparation-offering to YHWH:for Ashdod, one;for Gaza, one;for Ashkelon, one;for Gat trad. English “Gath.”, one;and for Ekron, one.

verses.hebrew: וְעַכְבְּרֵי הַזָּהָב מִסְפַּר כָּל־עָרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחֲמֵשֶׁת הַסְּרָנִים מֵעִיר מִבְצָר וְעַד כֹּפֶר הַפְּרָזִי וְעַד אָבֵל הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחוּ עָלֶיהָ אֵת אֲרוֹן יְהוָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בִּשְׂדֵה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֵּית־הַשִּׁמְשִׁי׃
verses.english: And the gold mice[were by] the number of all the towns of the Philistines, by the five overlords,from fortified town as far as rural village,as far as the great stone on which they deposited the Coffer of YHWH;until this day[it is] in the Field of Yehoshua the Bet-Shimshite.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ כִּי רָאוּ בַּאֲרוֹן יְהוָה וַיַּךְ בָּעָם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם כִּי־הִכָּה יְהוָה בָּעָם מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה
verses.english: But he struck down some of the men of Bet-Shemesh,for they had looked at the Coffer of YHWH;he struck down of the people seventy men [and] fifty thousand men.So the people mourned,for YHWH had struck down the people, a great striking-down.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ מִי יוּכַל לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה וְאֶל־מִי יַעֲלֶה מֵעָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: The men of Bet-Shemesh said:Who can stand in the presence of YHWH, this holy God?And to whom may it be brought up away from us?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִרְיַת־יְעָרִים לֵאמֹר הֵשִׁבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה רְדוּ הַעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ אֲלֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: So they sent messengers to the settled-folk of Kiryat-Ye’arim, saying:The Philistines have returned the Coffer of YHWH;go down, bring it up to you!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי קִרְיַת יְעָרִים וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־בֵּית אֲבִינָדָב בַּגִּבְעָה וְאֶת־אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ קִדְּשׁוּ לִשְׁמֹר אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So the men of Kiryat-Ye’arim came and brought up the Coffer of YHWH;they brought it to the house of Avinadav in Giv’a,and El’azar his son they hallowed to watch over the Coffer of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיּוֹם שֶׁבֶת הָאָרוֹן בְּקִרְיַת יְעָרִים וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַיִּהְיוּ עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וַיִּנָּהוּ כָּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now it was,from the time of the Coffer staying in Kiryat-Ye’arim,—the years became many, so that they became twenty years—that the whole House of Israel sighed after YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כָּל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִם־בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם אַתֶּם שָׁבִים אֶל־יְהוָה הָסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִתּוֹכְכֶם וְהָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְהָכִינוּ לְבַבְכֶם אֶל־יְהוָה וְעִבְדֻהוּ לְבַדּוֹ וְיַצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: So Shemuel said to the whole House of Israel, saying:If it is with all your heart that you are returning to YHWH,put away the foreign gods from your midst, including the Astartes;direct your hearts toward YHWH, and serve him alone,and he will rescue you from the hand of the Philistines!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסִירוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרֹת וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel put away the Baals and the Astartes,and served YHWH alone.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל קִבְצוּ אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּתָה וְאֶתְפַּלֵּל בַּעַדְכֶם אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And Shemuel said:Gather all Israel to Mitzpa/Lookout, so that I may intercede on your behalf to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ הַמִּצְפָּתָה וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיָּצוּמוּ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׁם חָטָאנוּ לַיהוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: They were gathered to Mitzpa;then they drew water and poured it out in the presence of YHWH,and fasted on that day.They declared there:We have sinned against YHWH!And Shemuel acted-as-judge for the Children of Israel at Mitzpa.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־הִתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּצְפָּתָה וַיַּעֲלוּ סַרְנֵי־פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: The Philistines heard that the Children of Israel were gathered at Mitzpa,so the Philistine overlords went up against Israel;and the Children of Israel heard, and they became afraid before the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל אַל־תַּחֲרֵשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ מִזְּעֹק אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵנוּ מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel said to Shemuel:Do not be silent from us, from crying out to YHWH our God,that he may deliver us from the hand of the Philistines!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל טְלֵה חָלָב אֶחָד ויעלה [וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ] עוֹלָה כָּלִיל לַיהוָה וַיִּזְעַק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה בְּעַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So Shemuel took a suckling lamb and offered it up as an offering-up, a whole-offering, to YHWH,and Shemuel cried out to YHWH on behalf of Israel,and YHWH answered him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שְׁמוּאֵל מַעֲלֶה הָעוֹלָה וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִגְּשׁוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּרְעֵם יְהוָה בְּקוֹל־גָּדוֹל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עַל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהֻמֵּם וַיִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Shemuel was offering up the offering-up,that the Philistines approached for battle against Israel.And YHWH thundered with a great sound on that day against the Philistines;he panicked them, so that they were defeated before Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הַמִּצְפָּה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכּוּם עַד־מִתַּחַת לְבֵית כָּר׃
verses.english: The men of Israel went out from Mitzpaand pursued the Philistines,and they struck them as far as below Bet-Kar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶבֶן אַחַת וַיָּשֶׂם בֵּין־הַמִּצְפָּה וּבֵין הַשֵּׁן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ אֶבֶן הָעָזֶר וַיֹּאמַר עַד־הֵנָּה עֲזָרָנוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Then Shemuel took a stone and put it between Mitzpa and Shen/ The Tooth-Rockand called its name Even Ha-Ezer/The Stone of Help;he said:Near here, YHWH helped us!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכָּנְעוּ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לָבוֹא בִּגְבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי יַד־יְהוָה בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁמוּאֵל׃
verses.english: So the Philistines were humbled;they no longer came anymore into the territory of Israel,and the hand of YHWH was against the Philistines all the days of Shemuel.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּשֹׁבְנָה הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ־פְלִשְׁתִּים מֵאֵת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֶקְרוֹן וְעַד־גַּת וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָן הִצִּיל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיְהִי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין הָאֱמֹרִי׃
verses.english: The towns that the Philistines had taken away from Israel returned to Israel,from Ekron as far as Gat,while their territory Israel rescued from the hand of the Philistines.Now there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃
verses.english: Shemuel led Israel as judge all the days of his life:

verses.hebrew: וְהָלַךְ מִדֵּי שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה וְסָבַב בֵּית־אֵל וְהַגִּלְגָּל וְהַמִּצְפָּה וְשָׁפַט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כָּל־הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: he would go year after year,circling about Bet-El, Gilgal, and Mitzpa,and would act-as-judge over Israel near all these sacred-places;

verses.hebrew: וּתְשֻׁבָתוֹ הָרָמָתָה כִּי־שָׁם בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁם שָׁפָט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: then his return [would be] to Rama, for there was his house,and there he would act-as-judge over Israel.He built there an altar to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר זָקֵן שְׁמוּאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־בָּנָיו שֹׁפְטִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Shemuel had grown old,that he made his sons judges for Israel

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי שֶׁם־בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר יוֹאֵל וְשֵׁם מִשְׁנֵהוּ אֲבִיָּה שֹׁפְטִים בִּבְאֵר שָׁבַע׃
verses.english: —the name of his firstborn son was Yoel,and the name of his second, Aviyya and ah-vee-YAH; trad. English “Joel … Abijah.” The names are ironically pious ones, meaning “YHWH Is God” and “Father [God] Is YHWH,” respectively. —judges in Be’er-Sheva.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בָנָיו בדרכו [בִּדְרָכָיו] וַיִּטּוּ אַחֲרֵי הַבָּצַע וַיִּקְחוּ־שֹׁחַד וַיַּטּוּ מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: But his sons did not walk in his ways:they turned aside after profit,and they took bribes and cast aside cases-for-justice.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ כֹּל זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל הָרָמָתָה׃
verses.english: So all the elders of Israel gathered togetherand came to Shemuel at Rama;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אַתָּה זָקַנְתָּ וּבָנֶיךָ לֹא הָלְכוּ בִּדְרָכֶיךָ עַתָּה שִׂימָה־לָּנוּ מֶלֶךְ לְשָׁפְטֵנוּ כְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: they said to him:Here, you have grown old,and your sons have not walked in your ways.So-now,make us a king to lead us, like all the nations!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי שְׁמוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ תְּנָה־לָּנוּ מֶלֶךְ לְשָׁפְטֵנוּ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The matter was evil in the eyes of Shemuel, when they said:Give us a king to lead us!So Shemuel prayed to YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמַע בְּקוֹל הָעָם לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ כִּי לֹא אֹתְךָ מָאָסוּ כִּי־אֹתִי מָאֲסוּ מִמְּלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and YHWH said to Shemuel:Hearken to the voice of the people in all that they say to you;for it is not you they have rejected,rather, it is me they have rejected from being king over them,

verses.hebrew: כְּכָל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ מִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיַּעַזְבֻנִי וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים כֵּן הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים גַּם־לָךְ׃
verses.english: just like all the deeds that they have donefrom the day I brought them up from Egypt until this day:they have abandoned meand served other gods!Thus they are doing to you as well!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם אַךְ כִּי־הָעֵד תָּעִיד בָּהֶם וְהִגַּדְתָּ לָהֶם מִשְׁפַּט הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So-now, hearken to their voice.However, you are to warn, yes, warn them;you are to tell them the rule of the king who will reign asking over them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כָּל־דִּבְרֵי יְהוָה אֶל־הָעָם הַשֹּׁאֲלִים מֵאִתּוֹ מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And Shemuel related all the words of YHWHto the people who were requesting a king from him;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה יִהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְשָׂם לוֹ בְּמֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו וְרָצוּ לִפְנֵי מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: he said:This will be the rule of the king who will reign as king over you:your sons he will take away,setting them in his chariotry and among his riders,so that they run ahead of his chariotry,

verses.hebrew: וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי חֲמִשִּׁים וְלַחֲרֹשׁ חֲרִישׁוֹ וְלִקְצֹר קְצִירוֹ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת כְּלֵי־מִלְחַמְתּוֹ וּכְלֵי רִכְבּוֹ׃
verses.english: to make them commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties,to plow his plowing and harvest his harvest,and to make his battle weapons and his chariot weapons;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם יִקָּח לְרַקָּחוֹת וּלְטַבָּחוֹת וּלְאֹפוֹת׃
verses.english: your daughters he will take awayas ointment-mixers, as cooks, and as bakers;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־שְׂדוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־כַּרְמֵיכֶם וְזֵיתֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים יִקָּח וְנָתַן לַעֲבָדָיו׃
verses.english: your fields, your vineyards, and your olive-groves, the best ones, he will take awayand give to his servants;

verses.hebrew: וְזַרְעֵיכֶם וְכַרְמֵיכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְנָתַן לְסָרִיסָיו וְלַעֲבָדָיו׃
verses.english: your sowing-seed and your vine-fruit he will titheand give to his officers and to his servants;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַבְדֵיכֶם וְאֶת־שִׁפְחוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־בַּחוּרֵיכֶם הַטּוֹבִים וְאֶת־חֲמוֹרֵיכֶם יִקָּח וְעָשָׂה לִמְלַאכְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: your servants, your maids, your best young-men, and your donkeys, he will take away,that they may do his work;

verses.hebrew: צֹאנְכֶם יַעְשֹׂר וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ־לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים׃
verses.english: your flock he will tithe,and you yourselves will be slaves for him.

verses.hebrew: וּזְעַקְתֶּם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מִלִּפְנֵי מַלְכְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם לָכֶם וְלֹא־יַעֲנֶה יְהוָה אֶתְכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃
verses.english: And you will cry out on that daybecause of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves,but YHWH will not answer you on that day!

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֲנוּ הָעָם לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל שְׁמוּאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹּא כִּי אִם־מֶלֶךְ יִהְיֶה עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: But the people refused to hearken to Shemuel’s voice; they said:No!Rather, let there be a king over us

verses.hebrew: וְהָיִינוּ גַם־אֲנַחְנוּ כְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם וּשְׁפָטָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ וְיָצָא לְפָנֵינוּ וְנִלְחַם אֶת־מִלְחֲמֹתֵנוּ׃
verses.english: so that we, we too may be like all the nations!Let our king lead usand go out before usand fight battles for us!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הָעָם וַיְדַבְּרֵם בְּאָזְנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Shemuel heard all the people’s words,and spoke them in the hearing of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמַע בְּקוֹלָם וְהִמְלַכְתָּ לָהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְכוּ אִישׁ לְעִירוֹ׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Shemuel:Hearken to their voice:you are to king them a king!Then Shemuel said to the men of Israel:Go back, each to his town.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־אִישׁ מבן־ימין [מִבִּנְיָמִין] וּשְׁמוֹ קִישׁ בֶּן־אֲבִיאֵל בֶּן־צְרוֹר בֶּן־בְּכוֹרַת בֶּן־אֲפִיחַ בֶּן־אִישׁ יְמִינִי גִּבּוֹר חָיִל׃
verses.english: Now there was a man of Binyamin—his name was Kish son of Aviel son of Tzeror son of Bekhorat son of Afiakh,the son of a [Bin]yaminite man,a mighty-man of value in these books often means “valor,” as a measure of military excellence, but here, as with some other biblical terms for “strength,” it can refer to high economic status as well..

verses.hebrew: וְלוֹ־הָיָה בֵן וּשְׁמוֹ שָׁאוּל בָּחוּר וָטוֹב וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכָּל־הָעָם׃
verses.english: He had a son—his name was Sha’ul trad. English “Saul.” /Requested-One:a youth, and goodly;now there was no man of the Children of Israel goodlier than he,from his shoulders and upward, taller than all the people.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאבַדְנָה הָאֲתֹנוֹת לְקִישׁ אֲבִי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר קִישׁ אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּנוֹ קַח־נָא אִתְּךָ אֶת־אַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקוּם לֵךְ בַּקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנֹת׃
verses.english: And the she-asses of Kish, the father of Sha’ul, strayed,so Kish said to Sha’ul his son:Pray take with you one of the serving-ladsand arise, go, look for the she-asses!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּהַר־אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶרֶץ־שָׁלִשָׁה וְלֹא מָצָאוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְאֶרֶץ־שַׁעֲלִים וָאַיִן וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּאֶרֶץ־יְמִינִי וְלֹא מָצָאוּ׃
verses.english: They crossed the highlands of Efrayim and crossed the region of Shalisha, but they did not find them;and they crossed the region of Shaalim, but—nothing;and they crossed the region of [Bin]yamin, but they did not find them.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה בָּאוּ בְּאֶרֶץ צוּף וְשָׁאוּל אָמַר לְנַעֲרוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ לְכָה וְנָשׁוּבָה פֶּן־יֶחְדַּל אָבִי מִן־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָנוּ׃
verses.english: They had [just] come to the region of Tzuf,when Sha’ul said to his serving-lad who was with him:Go, let’s turn back,lest my father stop [caring] about the she-asses and worry about us!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנֵּה־נָא אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִים בָּעִיר הַזֹּאת וְהָאִישׁ נִכְבָּד כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יְדַבֵּר בּוֹא יָבוֹא עַתָּה נֵלֲכָה שָּׁם אוּלַי יַגִּיד לָנוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּנוּ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַכְנוּ עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: But he said to him:Here, there is a man of God in this town;the man is honored—all that he speaks comes, yes, comes-to-pass.Now let us go there;perhaps he can tell us about our way on which we have gone.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנַעֲרוֹ וְהִנֵּה נֵלֵךְ וּמַה־נָּבִיא לָאִישׁ כִּי הַלֶּחֶם אָזַל מִכֵּלֵינוּ וּתְשׁוּרָה אֵין־לְהָבִיא לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים מָה אִתָּנוּ׃
verses.english: Sha’ul said to his lad:But here, if we go,what can we bring identical in sound with the word for “prophet.” for the man?For the food is gone from our vessels,and there is no present to bring to the man of God.What is with us?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף הַנַּעַר לַעֲנוֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה נִמְצָא בְיָדִי רֶבַע שֶׁקֶל כָּסֶף וְנָתַתִּי לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְהִגִּיד לָנוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: The lad answered Sha’ul further,he said:Here, I find in my hand a quarter weight of silver;I will give it to the man of God, so that he may tell us about our way.

verses.hebrew: לְפָנִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה־אָמַר הָאִישׁ בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לִדְרוֹשׁ אֱלֹהִים לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה עַד־הָרֹאֶה כִּי לַנָּבִיא הַיּוֹם יִקָּרֵא לְפָנִים הָרֹאֶה׃
verses.english: —Formerly in Israel,thus would a man say when he went to inquire of God:Go, let us go to the seer.For a prophet today was formerly called a seer.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנַעֲרוֹ טוֹב דְּבָרְךָ לְכָה נֵלֵכָה וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Sha’ul said to his lad:Your words are good;Go, let’s go!So they went to the town where the man of God was.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה עֹלִים בְּמַעֲלֵה הָעִיר וְהֵמָּה מָצְאוּ נְעָרוֹת יֹצְאוֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶן הֲיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הָרֹאֶה׃
verses.english: They were going up the ascent to the townwhen they found some girls coming out to draw water;they said to them:Is the seer in this place?

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲנֶינָה אוֹתָם וַתֹּאמַרְנָה יֵּשׁ הִנֵּה לְפָנֶיךָ מַהֵר עַתָּה כִּי הַיּוֹם בָּא לָעִיר כִּי זֶבַח הַיּוֹם לָעָם בַּבָּמָה׃
verses.english: They answered them and said:He is—here, ahead of you;go quickly now,for just now he has come to town,for there is a sacrificial-meal today for the people at the sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: כְּבֹאֲכֶם הָעִיר כֵּן תִּמְצְאוּן אֹתוֹ בְּטֶרֶם יַעֲלֶה הַבָּמָתָה לֶאֱכֹל כִּי לֹא־יֹאכַל הָעָם עַד־בֹּאוֹ כִּי־הוּא יְבָרֵךְ הַזֶּבַח אַחֲרֵי־כֵן יֹאכְלוּ הַקְּרֻאִים וְעַתָּה עֲלוּ כִּי־אֹתוֹ כְהַיּוֹם תִּמְצְאוּן אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: As soon as you come into the town, you will find him,before he goes up to the sanctuary to eat—for the people will not eat until his coming,for he must bless the sacrifice;after that, the invited-guests may eat.So-now, go up;as for him, this very day you will find him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ הָעִיר הֵמָּה בָּאִים בְּתוֹךְ הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׁמוּאֵל יֹצֵא לִקְרָאתָם לַעֲלוֹת הַבָּמָה׃
verses.english: So they went up to the town.They were coming into the midst of the town,and here, Shemuel was coming out toward themto go up to the sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה גָּלָה אֶת־אֹזֶן שְׁמוּאֵל יוֹם אֶחָד לִפְנֵי בוֹא־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now YHWH had bared Shemuel’s eara day before Sha’ul’s coming, saying:

verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת מָחָר אֶשְׁלַח אֵלֶיךָ אִישׁ מֵאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן וּמְשַׁחְתּוֹ לְנָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־עַמִּי מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי רָאִיתִי אֶת־עַמִּי כִּי בָּאָה צַעֲקָתוֹ אֵלָי׃
verses.english: Around this time tomorrowI will send to you a man from the region of Binyamin;you are to anoint him as Nagid Pronounced nah-GEED; others, “Prince,” but the term does not mean a king’s son. It probably indicates a military leader specially appointed by God, a “designate.” Because of ongoing debate about the term, I have left it in Hebrew. over my people Israel.He will deliver my people from the hand of the Philistines—for I have seen my people,for their cry as “indeed.” has come to me!

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל רָאָה אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיהוָה עָנָהוּ הִנֵּה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ זֶה יַעְצֹר בְּעַמִּי׃
verses.english: Now when Shemuel saw Sha’ul,YHWH declared to him:Here is the man about whom I said to you:This one shall keep rein on) that usually means “restrain” is puzzling. Many understand it as something like “govern.” my people!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ שָׁאוּל אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי אֵי־זֶה בֵּית הָרֹאֶה׃
verses.english: Sha’ul approached Shemuel amid the gatewayand said:Now tell me:Where is the seer’s house?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי הָרֹאֶה עֲלֵה לְפָנַי הַבָּמָה וַאֲכַלְתֶּם עִמִּי הַיּוֹם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּיךָ בַבֹּקֶר וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ אַגִּיד לָךְ׃
verses.english: Shemuel answered Sha’ul,he said:I am the seer.Go up ahead of me to the sanctuary;you are to eat with me today.Then I will send you off at daybreak,and all that is in your heart I will tell you.

verses.hebrew: וְלָאֲתֹנוֹת הָאֹבְדוֹת לְךָ הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים אַל־תָּשֶׂם אֶת־לִבְּךָ לָהֶם כִּי נִמְצָאוּ וּלְמִי כָּל־חֶמְדַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלוֹא לְךָ וּלְכֹל בֵּית אָבִיךָ׃
verses.english: As for the she-asses that were straying from you three days ago,do not take them to heart, for they have been found—and to whom do all the riches of Israel belong,is it not to you and to all your Father’s House?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא בֶן־יְמִינִי אָנֹכִי מִקַּטַנֵּי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִשְׁפַּחְתִּי הַצְּעִרָה מִכָּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת שִׁבְטֵי בִנְיָמִן וְלָמָּה דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלַי כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Sha’ul answered and said:Am I not a Binyaminite, from the smallest of the tribes of Israel,and my clan is the least of all the clans of the tribe of Binyamin?So why do you speak to me according to these words?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־נַעֲרוֹ וַיְבִיאֵם לִשְׁכָּתָה וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מָקוֹם בְּרֹאשׁ הַקְּרוּאִים וְהֵמָּה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Shemuel took Sha’ul and his serving-lad, brought them to the dining-halland gave them a place at the head of the invited-guests—they were about thirty men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל לַטַּבָּח תְּנָה אֶת־הַמָּנָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ שִׂים אֹתָהּ עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: Shemuel said to the cook:Give over the portion that I gave you,about which I said to you: Set it [aside] with you.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם הַטַּבָּח אֶת־הַשּׁוֹק וְהֶעָלֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם לִפְנֵי שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה הַנִּשְׁאָר שִׂים־לְפָנֶיךָ אֱכֹל כִּי לַמּוֹעֵד שָׁמוּר־לְךָ לֵאמֹר הָעָם קָרָאתִי וַיֹּאכַל שָׁאוּל עִם־שְׁמוּאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃
verses.english: So the cook raised the thigh and the fat-tail and offered it up and set it before Sha’ul.He said:Here is what-is-reserved;set it before you, eat,since for this appointed-time it has been kept for you, saying:I have invited the people.So Sha’ul ate with Shemuel on that day.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ מֵהַבָּמָה הָעִיר וַיְדַבֵּר עִם־שָׁאוּל עַל־הַגָּג׃
verses.english: Then they went down from the sanctuary to the town,and he spoke with Sha’ul on the roof.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ וַיְהִי כַּעֲלוֹת הַשַּׁחַר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל הגג [הַגָּגָה] לֵאמֹר קוּמָה וַאֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיָּקָם שָׁאוּל וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם הוּא וּשְׁמוּאֵל הַחוּצָה׃
verses.english: … they started-early;so it was, when dawn came up,that Shemuel called Sha’ul to the roof, saying:Arise, so that I may send you off.Sha’ul arose, and the two of them went forth, he and Shemuel, outside.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה יוֹרְדִים בִּקְצֵה הָעִיר וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱמֹר לַנַּעַר וְיַעֲבֹר לְפָנֵינוּ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאַתָּה עֲמֹד כַּיּוֹם וְאַשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת־דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: They were going down, at the edge of the town,when Shemuel said to Sha’ul:Speak to the lad, that he may cross over ahead of us,—and he crossed over—but you stop at once,that I may have you hear the word of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן וַיִּצֹק עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא כִּי־מְשָׁחֲךָ יְהוָה עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְנָגִיד׃
verses.english: And Shemuel took a flask of oil and poured it on his head and kissed him,and he said:Is it not [so] that YHWH has anointed you over his inheritance as Nagid?

verses.hebrew: בְּלֶכְתְּךָ הַיּוֹם מֵעִמָּדִי וּמָצָאתָ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִם־קְבֻרַת רָחֵל בִּגְבוּל בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֶלְצַח וְאָמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ לְבַקֵּשׁ וְהִנֵּה נָטַשׁ אָבִיךָ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְדָאַג לָכֶם לֵאמֹר מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לִבְנִי׃
verses.english: When you go today from me,you will find two men by Rahel’s burial-place in the territory of Binyamin, at Tzeltzah may be some kind of description—“rushing” or “limping”—and not a place name. The ancient versions are confused.;they will say to you:They are found, the she-asses that you went to look for!Here, your father has left off the matter of the she-asses,but he is worried about you, saying:What should I do about my son?

verses.hebrew: וְחָלַפְתָּ מִשָּׁם וָהָלְאָה וּבָאתָ עַד־אֵלוֹן תָּבוֹר וּמְצָאוּךָ שָּׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים עֹלִים אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים בֵּית־אֵל אֶחָד נֹשֵׂא שְׁלֹשָׁה גְדָיִים וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא שְׁלֹשֶׁת כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם וְאֶחָד נֹשֵׂא נֵבֶל־יָיִן׃
verses.english: So you are to move on from there, and further,and you are to come to the Oak of Tavor;they will find you, three men going up to [worship] God at Bet-El—one carrying three kids,one carrying three rounds of bread,and one carrying a skin of wine.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁאֲלוּ לְךָ לְשָׁלוֹם וְנָתְנוּ לְךָ שְׁתֵּי־לֶחֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ מִיָּדָם׃
verses.english: They will ask you after [your] welfare,and they will give you two bread-loaves;you are to take them from their hand.

verses.hebrew: אַחַר כֵּן תָּבוֹא גִּבְעַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם נְצִבֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וִיהִי כְבֹאֲךָ שָׁם הָעִיר וּפָגַעְתָּ חֶבֶל נְבִיאִים יֹרְדִים מֵהַבָּמָה וְלִפְנֵיהֶם נֵבֶל וְתֹף וְחָלִיל וְכִנּוֹר וְהֵמָּה מִתְנַבְּאִים׃
verses.english: After that, you will come to Giv’at Elohim/The Hill of God, where the Philistine garrison is;and it will be, when you come there, to the town,that you will encounter a band of prophets coming down from the sanctuary,and ahead of them, lyre and timbrel, flute and harp,and they will be ranting-in-prophecy.

verses.hebrew: וְצָלְחָה עָלֶיךָ רוּחַ יְהוָה וְהִתְנַבִּיתָ עִמָּם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ לְאִישׁ אַחֵר׃
verses.english: Now the rushing-spirit can mean either “spirit” or “wind,” so the concept might be seen as a spiritual one with physical force. of YHWH will advance upon you,so that you will rant-like-a-prophet with them,and you will be changed into another man.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תבאינה [תָבֹאנָה] הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה לָךְ עֲשֵׂה לְךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ כִּי הָאֱלֹהִים עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: And it will be,when these signs come-to-pass for you,do for yourself whatever your hand finds [to do]!For God is with you.

verses.hebrew: וְיָרַדְתָּ לְפָנַי הַגִּלְגָּל וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יֹרֵד אֵלֶיךָ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לִזְבֹּחַ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תּוֹחֵל עַד־בּוֹאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתִּי לְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: Then you are to go down ahead of me, to Gilgal,and here, I will be going down to you to offer up offerings-up and to sacrifice sacrifices of shalom.For seven days you are to tarry, until I come to you;then I will make known to you what you are to do.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּהַפְנֹתוֹ שִׁכְמוֹ לָלֶכֶת מֵעִם שְׁמוּאֵל וַיַּהֲפָךְ־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵב אַחֵר וַיָּבֹאוּ כָּל־הָאֹתוֹת הָאֵלֶּה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃
verses.english: Now it was,when he faced about to go from Shemuel,that God changed in him another heart,and all these signs came-to-pass on that day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ שָׁם הַגִּבְעָתָה וְהִנֵּה חֶבֶל־נְבִאִים לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְנַבֵּא בְּתוֹכָם׃
verses.english: They came there, to Giv’a,and here, a band of prophets, [coming] to meet him!The rushing-spirit of God advanced upon him,and he ranted-like-a-prophet in their midst.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָּל־יוֹדְעוֹ מֵאִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה עִם־נְבִאִים נִבָּא וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מַה־זֶּה הָיָה לְבֶן־קִישׁ הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִיאִים׃
verses.english: It was:all who knew him from yesterday [and] the day-before,when they sawthat here, with the prophets he was ranting-like-a-prophet,the people said, each one to his neighbor:What, now, has come over the son of Kish?Is Sha’ul too among the prophets?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ מִשָּׁם וַיֹּאמֶר וּמִי אֲבִיהֶם עַל־כֵּן הָיְתָה לְמָשָׁל הֲגַם שָׁאוּל בַּנְּבִאִים׃
verses.english: And a man from there spoke up and said:But who is their father?Therefore it became a proverb:Is Sha’ul too among the prophets?

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל מֵהִתְנַבּוֹת וַיָּבֹא הַבָּמָה׃
verses.english: He finished ranting-like-a-prophet, and came to the sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל אֵלָיו וְאֶל־נַעֲרוֹ אָן הֲלַכְתֶּם וַיֹּאמֶר לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־הָאֲתֹנוֹת וַנִּרְאֶה כִי־אַיִן וַנָּבוֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵל׃
verses.english: Now Sha’ul’s uncle said to him and to his serving-lad:Where did you go?He said:To look for the she-asses.And when we saw that [they were] not [there],we came to Shemuel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דּוֹד שָׁאוּל הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי מָה־אָמַר לָכֶם שְׁמוּאֵל׃
verses.english: Sha’ul’s uncle said:Pray tell me:What did Shemuel say to you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דּוֹדוֹ הַגֵּד הִגִּיד לָנוּ כִּי נִמְצְאוּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאֶת־דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה לֹא־הִגִּיד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל׃
verses.english: Sha’ul said to his uncle:He told, yes, told usthat the she-asses had been found.But as for the matter of the kingship,he did not tell him what Shemuel had said.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצְעֵק שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־יְהוָה הַמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: Now Shemuel summoned the people to YHWH, at Mitzpa.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם וָאַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כָּל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת הַלֹּחֲצִים אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: He said to the Children of Israel:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:I myself brought Israel up from Egypt,I rescued you from the hand of Egypt and from the hand of all the kingdoms that were oppressing you.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם הַיּוֹם מְאַסְתֶּם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא מוֹשִׁיעַ לָכֶם מִכָּל־רָעוֹתֵיכֶם וְצָרֹתֵיכֶם וַתֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כִּי־מֶלֶךְ תָּשִׂים עָלֵינוּ וְעַתָּה הִתְיַצְּבוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶם וּלְאַלְפֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: But you, today: you have rejected your God,the one delivering you from all your trials and your troubles !You said to him:No, rather, a king make over us!So-now,station yourselves in the presence of YHWH, by your tribes, by your families.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב שְׁמוּאֵל אֵת כָּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּלָּכֵד שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן׃
verses.english: So Shemuel brought near each of the tribes of Israel,and the tribe of Binyamin was captured-by-lot) is more commonly used to describe the conquest of territory in the Bible. See also Josh. 7:15–18 and I Sam. 14:41..

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־שֵׁבֶט בִּנְיָמִן למשפחתו [לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו] וַתִּלָּכֵד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטְרִי וַיִּלָּכֵד שָׁאוּל בֶּן־קִישׁ וַיְבַקְשֻׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃
verses.english: Then he brought near the tribe of Binyamin by its clans,and the Matrite clan was captured-by-lot;then Sha’ul son of Kish was captured-by-lot.But when they looked for him, he was not to be found.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־עוֹד בַּיהוָה הֲבָא עוֹד הֲלֹם אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה הִנֵּה־הוּא נֶחְבָּא אֶל־הַכֵּלִים׃
verses.english: So they inquired further of YHWH:Has any other man come here?YHWH said:Here, he has hidden himself among the gear!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֻצוּ וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ מִשָּׁם וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ הָעָם וַיִּגְבַּהּ מִכָּל־הָעָם מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמָעְלָה׃
verses.english: They ran and fetched him from thereand he stood amid the people,and he was taller than all the people, from his shoulders and upward.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם הַרְּאִיתֶם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ יְהוָה כִּי אֵין כָּמֹהוּ בְּכָל־הָעָם וַיָּרִעוּ כָל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then Shemuel said to all the people:Do you see whom YHWH has chosen?Indeed, there is none like him among all the people!And all the people shouted;they proclaimed: May the king live!

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אֵת מִשְׁפַּט הַמְּלֻכָה וַיִּכְתֹּב בַּסֵּפֶר וַיַּנַּח לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח שְׁמוּאֵל אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃
verses.english: And Shemuel spoke to the people, the rule of kingship,and wrote it in a record a written document. It only comes to mean “book” centuries later.,and put it in the presence of YHWH.Then Shemuel sent all the people off, each one to his house.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם־שָׁאוּל הָלַךְ לְבֵיתוֹ גִּבְעָתָה וַיֵּלְכוּ עִמּוֹ הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר־נָגַע אֱלֹהִים בְּלִבָּם׃
verses.english: And Sha’ul too went to his house at Giv’a,and there went with him the valiant oneswhose heart God had touched.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בְלִיַּעַל אָמְרוּ מַה־יֹּשִׁעֵנוּ זֶה וַיִּבְזֻהוּ וְלֹא־הֵבִיאוּ לוֹ מִנְחָה וַיְהִי כְּמַחֲרִישׁ׃
verses.english: Now some base fellows said:How can this one deliver us?So they despised himand did not bring him a gift.But he was like one silent to vayhi kemo hodesh (“Now it was about a month later”), thus connecting the phrase to 11:1..

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל נָחָשׁ הָעַמּוֹנִי וַיִּחַן עַל־יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ אֶל־נָחָשׁ כְּרָת־לָנוּ בְרִית וְנַעַבְדֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Now Nahash / Snake the Ammonite went upand encamped against Yavesh-Gil’ad.All the men of Yavesh said to Nahash:Cut a covenant with us, and we will serve you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם נָחָשׁ הָעַמּוֹנִי בְּזֹאת אֶכְרֹת לָכֶם בִּנְקוֹר לָכֶם כָּל־עֵין יָמִין וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ חֶרְפָּה עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But Nahash the Ammonite said to them:On this [condition] [condition]: Following Driver. I will cut [a covenant] with you—on [condition of] gouging out every one of your right eyes!Thus will I make it a disgrace upon all Israel!
