verses.english: So-now,let not my blood fall to the earth, away from the presence of YHWH!For the king of Israel has come out to seek a single flea,as one pursues a partridge in the hills!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל חָטָאתִי שׁוּב בְּנִי־דָוִד כִּי לֹא־אָרַע לְךָ עוֹד תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר יָקְרָה נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנֵּה הִסְכַּלְתִּי וָאֶשְׁגֶּה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Sha’ul said:I have sinned; return, my son David!For I will do evil to you no more,since my life was precious in your eyes this day.Here, I have acted-foolishly and have been in exceedingly great error!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה החנית [חֲנִית] הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶהָ׃
verses.english: David answered and said:Here is the king’s spear;let one of the serving-lads cross over and fetch it,

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה יָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ אֶת־צִדְקָתוֹ וְאֶת־אֱמֻנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נְתָנְךָ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם בְּיָד וְלֹא אָבִיתִי לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדִי בִּמְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: and may YHWH return upon each one his righteousness and his trustworthiness,[seeing] that YHWH gave you into my handbut I would not stretch out my hand against YHWH’s anointed.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה כַּאֲשֶׁר גָּדְלָה נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּעֵינָי כֵּן תִּגְדַּל נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְיַצִּלֵנִי מִכָּל־צָרָה׃
verses.english: Here, as your life has been deemed-great this day in my eyes,so may my life grow-great in YHWH’s eyes,and may he rescue me from every distress!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה בְּנִי דָוִד גַּם עָשֹׂה תַעֲשֶׂה וְגַם יָכֹל תּוּכָל וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד לְדַרְכּוֹ וְשָׁאוּל שָׁב לִמְקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: Sha’ul said to David:Blessed are you, my son David;you will do, yes, do [well],and you will prevail, yes, prevail!David went on his way, and Sha’ul returned to his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־לִבּוֹ עַתָּה אֶסָּפֶה יוֹם־אֶחָד בְּיַד־שָׁאוּל אֵין־לִי טוֹב כִּי הִמָּלֵט אִמָּלֵט אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְנוֹאַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי שָׁאוּל לְבַקְשֵׁנִי עוֹד בְּכָל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִמְלַטְתִּי מִיָּדוֹ׃
verses.english: David said in his heart:NowI will be swept away one day by the hand of Sha’ul;there is nothing better for me than that I should escape, yes, escape to the land of the Philistines—then Sha’ul will despair of me, of seeking me again throughout all the territory of Israel,and I will escape from his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם דָּוִד וַיַּעֲבֹר הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ אֶל־אָכִישׁ בֶּן־מָעוֹךְ מֶלֶךְ גַּת׃
verses.english: So David arose and crossed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Akhish son of Maokh, king of Gat.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד עִם־אָכִישׁ בְּגַת הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ דָּוִד וּשְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת־נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִית׃
verses.english: And David stayed with Akhish in Gat, he and his men, each one and his household,and David and his two wives,Ahinoam, the Yizre’elite, and Avigayil wife of Naval, the Carmelite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְשָׁאוּל כִּי־בָרַח דָּוִד גַּת וְלֹא־יוסף [יָסַף] עוֹד לְבַקְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: It was told to Sha’ul that David had gotten away to Gat,and he did not continue to seek him anymore.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יִתְּנוּ־לִי מָקוֹם בְּאַחַת עָרֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְאֵשְׁבָה שָּׁם וְלָמָּה יֵשֵׁב עַבְדְּךָ בְּעִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: David said to Akhish:Now if I have found favor in your eyes,let there be given to me a place in one of the country towns, and let me settle there;why should your servant settle in the royal city with you?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אָכִישׁ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־צִקְלָג לָכֵן הָיְתָה צִקְלַג לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So Akhish gave him Tziklag on that day;therefore Tziklag came-to-belong to the kings of Judah, until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁב דָּוִד בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים יָמִים וְאַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים׃
verses.english: Now the number of days that David stayed in Philistine country was a year and four months.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיִּפְשְׁטוּ אֶל־הַגְּשׁוּרִי והגרזי [וְהַגִּזְרִי] וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי כִּי הֵנָּה יֹשְׁבוֹת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם בּוֹאֲךָ שׁוּרָה וְעַד־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: And David would go up, along with his men;they would sweep down on the Geshurites, the Gizrites, and the Amalekites—for they were the settled-folk of the land who were [there] from ages [past]—as you come to Shur, as far as the land of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: וְהִכָּה דָוִד אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא יְחַיֶּה אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה וְלָקַח צֹאן וּבָקָר וַחֲמֹרִים וּגְמַלִּים וּבְגָדִים וַיָּשָׁב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָכִישׁ׃
verses.english: And David would strike the land;he would leave alive no man or woman,but he would take sheep and oxen, donkeys and camels and garments,and then he would return and come back to Akhish.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אַל־פְּשַׁטְתֶּם הַיּוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד עַל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב הַיַּרְחְמְאֵלִי וְאֶל־נֶגֶב הַקֵּינִי׃
verses.english: And Akhish would say:On [whom] did you sweep down today?And David would say:Against the Negev of Judah,or: against the Negev of the Yerahme’elites,or: against the Negev of the Kenites.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא־יְחַיֶּה דָוִד לְהָבִיא גַת לֵאמֹר פֶּן־יַגִּדוּ עָלֵינוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־עָשָׂה דָוִד וְכֹה מִשְׁפָּטוֹ כָּל־הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בִּשְׂדֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: But no man or woman would David leave alive to bring to Gat, saying:Lest they report concerning us, saying:Thus did David doand thus was his practice,all the days that he stayed in Philistine country.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲמֵן אָכִישׁ בְּדָוִד לֵאמֹר הַבְאֵשׁ הִבְאִישׁ בְּעַמּוֹ בְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיָה לִי לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: So Akhish came-to-trust David, saying:He has made himself reek, yes, reek so to his own people, to Israel,so he will be servant to me for a lifetime!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם לַצָּבָא לְהִלָּחֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי אִתִּי תֵּצֵא בַמַּחֲנֶה אַתָּה וַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ׃
verses.english: It was in those daysthat the Philistines gathered their camps into an armed-force, to wage battle against Israel.Akhish said to David:You know, yes, know that you must go out with me in the camp, you and your men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ לָכֵן אַתָּה תֵדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד לָכֵן שֹׁמֵר לְרֹאשִׁי אֲשִׂימְךָ כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: David said to Akhish:Then you yourself will know what your servant can do!So Akhish said to David:Then I will make you my chief bodyguard for all the days [to come]!

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמוּאֵל מֵת וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־לוֹ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בָרָמָה וּבְעִירוֹ וְשָׁאוּל הֵסִיר הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים מֵהָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Now Shemuel had died,and all Israel had beaten [the breast] for him and had buried him in Rama, in his town.Now Sha’ul had removed [those inquiring of] ghosts and all- knowing ones from the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְשׁוּנֵם וַיִּקְבֹּץ שָׁאוּל אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃
verses.english: And the Philistines gathered and came, encamping at Shunem,while Sha’ul gathered all Israel, encamping at Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שָׁאוּל אֶת־מַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּרָא וַיֶּחֱרַד לִבּוֹ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Sha’ul saw the Philistines’ campand he became afraid and y-r-’) echo each other throughout the narrative (twelve times in total). Both at the beginning and the end, Sha’ul’s seeing will lead to his being afraid., and his heart trembled exceedingly.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל שָׁאוּל בַּיהוָה וְלֹא עָנָהוּ יְהוָה גַּם בַּחֲלֹמוֹת גַּם בָּאוּרִים גַּם בַּנְּבִיאִם׃
verses.english: So Sha’ul made request Pronounced oo-REEM, this was some sort of object used in determining the future; see note to 14:41, above. of YHWH,but YHWH did not answer him,either through dreams, or through Urim, or through prophets.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לַעֲבָדָיו בַּקְּשׁוּ־לִי אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב וְאֵלְכָה אֵלֶיהָ וְאֶדְרְשָׁה־בָּהּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אֵשֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־אוֹב בְּעֵין דּוֹר׃
verses.english: So Sha’ul said to his servants:Seek for me a woman, a possessor of ghosts,that I may go to her, that I may inquire of [the dead] through her.His servants said to him:There is a woman, a possessor of ghosts at En Dor.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ שָׁאוּל וַיִּלְבַּשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הוּא וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים עִמּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה לָיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר קסומי־[קָסֳמִי־] נָא לִי בָּאוֹב וְהַעֲלִי לִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלָיִךְ׃
verses.english: Sha’ul disguised himself and clothed himself in other garments,and he went, he and two men with him,and came to the woman at night.He said:Now divine for me by a ghost;bring up for me the one whom I will designate to you.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֵלָיו הִנֵּה אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִית אֶת־הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִי מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלָמָה אַתָּה מִתְנַקֵּשׁ בְּנַפְשִׁי לַהֲמִיתֵנִי׃
verses.english: The woman said to him:Here, you know what Sha’ul has done,how he has cut off [those inquiring of] ghosts and all-knowing ones from the land.So why would you ensnare my life, to cause my death?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע לָהּ שָׁאוּל בַּיהוָה לֵאמֹר חַי־יְהוָה אִם־יִקְּרֵךְ עָוֺן בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Sha’ul swore to her by YHWH, saying:By the life of YHWH, should any guilt befall you through this matter … !

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־מִי אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל הַעֲלִי־לִי׃
verses.english: The woman said:Whom shall I bring up for you?He said:Bring up Shemuel for me.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵל וַתִּזְעַק בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה רִמִּיתָנִי וְאַתָּה שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: The woman saw Shemuel,and she cried out in a loud voice;the woman said to Sha’ul, saying:Why have you deceived me? For you are Sha’ul!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־תִּירְאִי כִּי מָה רָאִית וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל אֱלֹהִים רָאִיתִי עֹלִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The king said to her:Do not be afraid;rather, what do you see?The woman said to Sha’ul:I see a godlike-being coming up from the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מַה־תָּאֳרוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר אִישׁ זָקֵן עֹלֶה וְהוּא עֹטֶה מְעִיל וַיֵּדַע שָׁאוּל כִּי־שְׁמוּאֵל הוּא וַיִּקֹּד אַפַּיִם אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃
verses.english: He said to her:What is its form?She said:An old man is coming up,and he is wrapped in a cloak.Then Sha’ul knew that it was Shemuel,and he prostrated himself, nostrils to the earth, and bowed low.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל לָמָּה הִרְגַּזְתַּנִי לְהַעֲלוֹת אֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל צַר־לִי מְאֹד וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בִּי וֵאלֹהִים סָר מֵעָלַי וְלֹא־עָנָנִי עוֹד גַּם בְּיַד־הַנְּבִיאִם גַּם־בַּחֲלֹמוֹת וָאֶקְרָאֶה לְךָ לְהוֹדִיעֵנִי מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה׃
verses.english: Shemuel said to Sha’ul:Why have you disturbed me, by bringing me up?Sha’ul said:I am exceedingly distressed—the Philistines are waging battle against meand God has turned away from me:he no longer answers me,either through the hand of the prophets or through dreams.So I have called you to make known to me what I should do!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל וְלָמָּה תִּשְׁאָלֵנִי וַיהוָה סָר מֵעָלֶיךָ וַיְהִי עָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Shemuel said:But why do you make request of me? For YHWH has turned away from you and has become your foe Ancient versions read as ’im rei’ekha, “has gone over to your fellow” (David).!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוָה לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיָדִי וַיִּקְרַע יְהוָה אֶת־הַמַּמְלָכָה מִיָּדֶךָ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְרֵעֲךָ לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: YHWH has done to you as he promised through my hand:YHWH has torn away the kingdom from your handand has given it to your fellow, to David

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה וְלֹא־עָשִׂיתָ חֲרוֹן־אַפּוֹ בַּעֲמָלֵק עַל־כֵּן הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשָׂה־לְךָ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: —as you did not hearken to YHWH’s voice,and did not carry out his blazing anger against Amalek.Therefore this thing has YHWH done to you this day!

verses.hebrew: וְיִתֵּן יְהוָה גַּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמָחָר אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ עִמִּי גַּם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתֵּן יְהוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: And YHWH will also give Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines;tomorrow, you and your sons are with me;also the camp of Israel YHWH will give into the hand of the Philistines!

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל מְלֹא־קוֹמָתוֹ אַרְצָה וַיִּרָא מְאֹד מִדִּבְרֵי שְׁמוּאֵל גַּם־כֹּחַ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ כִּי לֹא אָכַל לֶחֶם כָּל־הַיּוֹם וְכָל־הַלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: Sha’ul quickly fell his full stature to the ground;he was exceedingly afraid at Shemuel’s words,also there was no strength in him,for he had not eaten food all day and all night.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַתֵּרֶא כִּי־נִבְהַל מְאֹד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה שָׁמְעָה שִׁפְחָתְךָ בְּקוֹלֶךָ וָאָשִׂים נַפְשִׁי בְּכַפִּי וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־דְּבָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֵלָי׃
verses.english: The woman came to Sha’ul,and she saw that he was exceedingly terrified,so she said to him:Here, your handmaid hearkened to your voice,and I put my life in my hand—I hearkened to your words which you spoke to me.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע־נָא גַם־אַתָּה בְּקוֹל שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וְאָשִׂמָה לְפָנֶיךָ פַּת־לֶחֶם וֶאֱכוֹל וִיהִי בְךָ כֹּחַ כִּי תֵלֵךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: So-then,now hearken, you also, to your handmaid’s voice:I will put before you a bit of bread—eat,so that there may be strength in you when you go on your way.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֹכַל וַיִּפְרְצוּ־בוֹ עֲבָדָיו וְגַם־הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּשְׁמַע לְקֹלָם וַיָּקָם מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶל־הַמִּטָּה׃
verses.english: He refused, and said: I will not eat!But his servants pressed him, and also the woman,so he hearkened to their voice;he arose from the ground and sat down on the couch.

verses.hebrew: וְלָאִשָּׁה עֵגֶל־מַרְבֵּק בַּבַּיִת וַתְּמַהֵר וַתִּזְבָּחֵהוּ וַתִּקַּח־קֶמַח וַתָּלָשׁ וַתֹּפֵהוּ מַצּוֹת׃
verses.english: Now the woman had a stall-fed calf in the house;she hurried and slew it,took meal and kneaded it, and baked it into unleavened-cakes.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּגֵּשׁ לִפְנֵי־שָׁאוּל וְלִפְנֵי עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא׃
verses.english: Then she brought it close before Sha’ul and before his servants, and they ate,and they arose and went away, that [very] night.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּצוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־כָּל־מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲפֵקָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹנִים בַּעַיִן אֲשֶׁר בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃
verses.english: The Philistines gathered all their encampments at Afek,while Israel was encamped at the spring that is in Yizre’el.

verses.hebrew: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֹבְרִים לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים וְדָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו עֹבְרִים בָּאַחֲרֹנָה עִם־אָכִישׁ׃
verses.english: Now the Philistine overlords were crossing over by [divisions of] hundreds and by [divisions of] thousands,with David and his men crossing over in the rear, beside Akhish.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים מָה הָעִבְרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר אָכִישׁ אֶל־שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד עֶבֶד שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אִתִּי זֶה יָמִים אוֹ־זֶה שָׁנִים וְלֹא־מָצָאתִי בוֹ מְאוּמָה מִיּוֹם נָפְלוֹ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: The Philistine commanders said:What [about] these Hebrews?Akhish said to the Philistine commanders:Is this not David, servant of Sha’ul king of Israel,who has been with me for these days and these years,yet I have found nothing [amiss] in him, from the day of his falling in [with us] until this day?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצְפוּ עָלָיו שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים הָשֵׁב אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְיָשֹׁב אֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִפְקַדְתּוֹ שָׁם וְלֹא־יֵרֵד עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ לְשָׂטָן בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּבַמֶּה יִתְרַצֶּה זֶה אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו הֲלוֹא בְּרָאשֵׁי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם׃
verses.english: The Philistine commanders became furious with him,and the Philistine commanders said to him:Return the man, and let him return to his place which you assigned him,but do not let him go down with us into battle,so that he will not be an adversary to us in battle!For whereby will this one make himself acceptable [again] to his lord—is it not with the heads of those men?

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־זֶה דָוִד אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנוּ־לוֹ בַּמְּחֹלוֹת לֵאמֹר הִכָּה שָׁאוּל בַּאֲלָפָיו וְדָוִד ברבבתו [בְּרִבְבֹתָיו׃]
verses.english: Is this not David,about whom they chanted with dancing, saying: Sha’ul has struck down his thousands, but David—his myriads?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אָכִישׁ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו חַי־יְהוָה כִּי־יָשָׁר אַתָּה וְטוֹב בְּעֵינַי צֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ אִתִּי בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי לֹא־מָצָאתִי בְךָ רָעָה מִיּוֹם בֹּאֲךָ אֵלַי עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבְעֵינֵי הַסְּרָנִים לֹא־טוֹב אָתָּה׃
verses.english: So Akhish had David calledand said to him:By the life of YHWH,indeed, you are upright,and good in my eyes is your going out and your coming in with me in the camp,for I have not found any evil in you from the day of your coming to me until this day—but in the eyes of the Philistine overlords you are not good!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שׁוּב וְלֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂה רָע בְּעֵינֵי סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: So-now,turn back, and go in peace,so that you do not do evil in the eyes of the Philistine overlords.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אָכִישׁ כִּי מֶה עָשִׂיתִי וּמַה־מָּצָאתָ בְעַבְדְּךָ מִיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתִי לְפָנֶיךָ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי לֹא אָבוֹא וְנִלְחַמְתִּי בְּאֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: David said to Akhish:Indeed, what have I done;what have you found in your servantfrom the day that I was [first] before you, until this day,that I may not come and wage battle against the enemies of my lord king?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אָכִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־דָּוִד יָדַעְתִּי כִּי טוֹב אַתָּה בְּעֵינַי כְּמַלְאַךְ אֱלֹהִים אַךְ שָׂרֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים אָמְרוּ לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עִמָּנוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Akhish answered and said to David:I acknowledge that you are as good in my eyes as a messenger of a god;however, the Philistine commanders say:He must not go up with us into battle!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הַשְׁכֵּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ אִתָּךְ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּם בַּבֹּקֶר וְאוֹר לָכֶם וָלֵכוּ׃
verses.english: So-now, start-early at daybreak,and as for your lord’s servants who came with you,you are [all] to start-early at daybreak;when it is light for you, go!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו לָלֶכֶת בַּבֹּקֶר לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּפְלִשְׁתִּים עָלוּ יִזְרְעֶאל׃
verses.english: So David started-early, he and his men, to go at daybreak, to return to the land of the Philistines,while the Philistines went up to Yizre’el.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו צִקְלַג בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַעֲמָלֵקִי פָשְׁטוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב וְאֶל־צִקְלַג וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־צִקְלַג וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָהּ בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: It was, when David came and his men to Tziklag, on the third day—now Amalekites had swept down on the Negev, on Tziklag;they had struck Tziklag, and burned it with fire,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל לֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ וַיִּנְהֲגוּ וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם׃
verses.english: and they had taken captive the women that were in it, from young to old.They had not put any [of them] to death,but had led them away and gone on their way—

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ׃
verses.english: David and his men came to the town,and here, it was burned down with fire,with their wives and their sons and their daughters taken captive!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא דָוִד וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ עַד אֲשֶׁר אֵין־בָּהֶם כֹּחַ לִבְכּוֹת׃
verses.english: And David and the fighting-people that were with him lifted up their voice and weptuntil there was no strength in them to weep.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי נְשֵׁי־דָוִד נִשְׁבּוּ אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃
verses.english: Now David’s two wives had been taken captive,Ahinoam the Yizre’elite and Avigayil wife of Naval the Carmelite.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֶר לְדָוִד מְאֹד כִּי־אָמְרוּ הָעָם לְסָקְלוֹ כִּי־מָרָה נֶפֶשׁ כָּל־הָעָם אִישׁ עַל־בנו [בָּנָיו] וְעַל־בְּנֹתָיו וַיִּתְחַזֵּק דָּוִד בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
verses.english: And David was exceedingly distressed,for the people intended to stone him,for bitter were all the people’s feelings,each one over his sons and over his daughters—but David found strength in YHWH his God.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֵן בֶּן־אֲחִימֶלֶךְ הַגִּישָׁה־נָּא לִי הָאֵפֹד וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֶבְיָתָר אֶת־הָאֵפֹד אֶל־דָּוִד׃
verses.english: David said to Evyatar the priest, son of Ahimelekh:Now bring the efod close to me!Evyatar brought the efod close to David.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהוָה לֵאמֹר אֶרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי הַגְּדוּד־הַזֶּה הַאַשִּׂגֶנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רְדֹף כִּי־הַשֵּׂג תַּשִּׂיג וְהַצֵּל תַּצִּיל׃
verses.english: And David inquired of YHWH, saying:Shall I pursue after this raiding-band?Will I overtake them?He said to him:Pursue,for you will overtake, yes, overtake, and will rescue, yes, rescue [them]!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הוּא וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וְהַנּוֹתָרִים עָמָדוּ׃
verses.english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him,and they came to Wadi Besor, while those left stayed behind.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף דָּוִד הוּא וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר פִּגְּרוּ מֵעֲבֹר אֶת־נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר׃
verses.english: And David gave pursuit, he and four hundred men,while two hundred men stayed behind, who were [too] exhausted to cross Wadi Besor.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ־מִצְרִי בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּקְחוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל וַיַּשְׁקֻהוּ מָיִם׃
verses.english: They found an Egyptian man in the open-field, and took him to David;they gave him bread and he ate, and they had him drink water,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ פֶלַח דְּבֵלָה וּשְׁנֵי צִמֻּקִים וַיֹּאכַל וַתָּשָׁב רוּחוֹ אֵלָיו כִּי לֹא־אָכַל לֶחֶם וְלֹא־שָׁתָה מַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה לֵילוֹת׃
verses.english: and they gave him a slice of pressed-figs and two raisin-bunches, and he ate.Then his spirit returned to him—for he had not eaten bread and had not drunk water for three days and three nights.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד לְמִי־אַתָּה וְאֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר נַעַר מִצְרִי אָנֹכִי עֶבֶד לְאִישׁ עֲמָלֵקִי וַיַּעַזְבֵנִי אֲדֹנִי כִּי חָלִיתִי הַיּוֹם שְׁלֹשָׁה׃
verses.english: And David said to him:To whom do you [belong]? And where are you from?He said:I am an Egyptian serving-lad, the servant of an Amalekite man;my lord abandoned me, since I became sick three days ago.

verses.hebrew: אֲנַחְנוּ פָּשַׁטְנוּ נֶגֶב הַכְּרֵתִי וְעַל־אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה וְעַל־נֶגֶב כָּלֵב וְאֶת־צִקְלַג שָׂרַפְנוּ בָאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: We were sweeping down on the Negev of the Kereitites,against what belongs to Judah,and against the Negev of Calev,and Tziklag we burned with fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד הֲתוֹרִדֵנִי אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָה לִּי בֵאלֹהִים אִם־תְּמִיתֵנִי וְאִם־תַּסְגִּרֵנִי בְּיַד־אֲדֹנִי וְאוֹרִדְךָ אֶל־הַגְּדוּד הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: David said to him:Will you bring me down to this band?He said:Swear to me by Godif you should put me to death, if you should turn me over to the hand of my [former] lord … !Then I will bring you down to this band.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרִדֵהוּ וְהִנֵּה נְטֻשִׁים עַל־פְּנֵי כָל־הָאָרֶץ אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וְחֹגְגִים בְּכֹל הַשָּׁלָל הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ מֵאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: He brought him down,and here, they were stretched out all over the surface of the ground,eating and drinking and celebratingamong all the great spoil that they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from the land of Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם דָּוִד מֵהַנֶּשֶׁף וְעַד־הָעֶרֶב לְמָחֳרָתָם וְלֹא־נִמְלַט מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם־אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ־נַעַר אֲשֶׁר־רָכְבוּ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּים וַיָּנֻסוּ׃
verses.english: And David struck them from the [dawn] breeze until the morrow’s sunset;not one of them escaped except for four hundred serving-lads who mounted camels and fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּל דָּוִד אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ עֲמָלֵק וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו הִצִּיל דָּוִד׃
verses.english: So David rescued everything that Amalek had taken,and his two wives David rescued [as well];

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא נֶעְדַּר־לָהֶם מִן־הַקָּטֹן וְעַד־הַגָּדוֹל וְעַד־בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת וּמִשָּׁלָל וְעַד כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לָקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּל הֵשִׁיב דָּוִד׃
verses.english: nothing was missing of theirs, from small to great, to sons and daughters,or from the spoils to anything that they took for themselves—everything David restored.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־כָּל־הַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר נָהֲגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּקְנֶה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֶה שְׁלַל דָּוִד׃
verses.english: David took all the flocks and all the herds;they drove them before that livestock and said:These are David’s spoils!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־מָאתַיִם הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־פִּגְּרוּ מִלֶּכֶת אַחֲרֵי דָוִד וַיֹּשִׁיבֻם בְּנַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וְלִקְרַאת הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם וַיִּשְׁאַל לָהֶם לְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: And David came back to the two hundred men that had been too exhausted to go after David—they had had them stay at Wadi Besor—and they went out to meet David and to meet the fighting-people who were with him.And David came close to the people, and he inquired of them for peace,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן כָּל־אִישׁ־רָע וּבְלִיַּעַל מֵהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ עִם־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָלְכוּ עִמִּי לֹא־נִתֵּן לָהֶם מֵהַשָּׁלָל אֲשֶׁר הִצַּלְנוּ כִּי־אִם־אִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְיִנְהֲגוּ וְיֵלֵכוּ׃
verses.english: but every evil and base man of the men who had gone with David spoke upand said:Because they did not go with me,we will not give them any of the spoils that we rescuedexcept to each one his wife and his children;let them drive [these] away and go!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ כֵן אֶחָי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן יְהוָה לָנוּ וַיִּשְׁמֹר אֹתָנוּ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַגְּדוּד הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ׃
verses.english: David said:You must not do thus, my brothers,with what YHWH has given us!—he watched over us and gave the band that came against us, into our hand.

verses.hebrew: וּמִי יִשְׁמַע לָכֶם לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי כְּחֵלֶק הַיֹּרֵד בַּמִּלְחָמָה וּכְחֵלֶק הַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־הַכֵּלִים יַחְדָּו יַחֲלֹקוּ׃
verses.english: For who would hearken to you in this matter?Indeed, like the share of the one who goes down into battle is the share of the one who stays by the gear:together they shall divide-shares.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵהַיּוֹם הַהוּא וָמָעְלָה וַיְשִׂמֶהָ לְחֹק וּלְמִשְׁפָּט לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So it was from that day and forwardthat they made it a prescribed-law and a rule in Israel,until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־צִקְלַג וַיְשַׁלַּח מֵהַשָּׁלָל לְזִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לְרֵעֵהוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה לָכֶם בְּרָכָה מִשְּׁלַל אֹיְבֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: David came back to Tziklag, and he sent off [some] of the spoils to the elders of Judah, to his fellows, saying:Here, it is a blessing-gift for you, from the spoil of YHWH’s enemies:

verses.hebrew: לַאֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָמוֹת־נֶגֶב וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּיַתִּר׃
verses.english: for those in Bet-El, for those in Ramot-Negev, for those in Yattir,

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲרֹעֵר וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּשִׂפְמוֹת וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּאֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ׃
verses.english: for those in Aro’er, for those in Sifmot, for those in Eshtemoa,

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּרָכָל וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַיְּרַחְמְאֵלִי וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי הַקֵּינִי׃
verses.english: for those in Rakhal, for those in the Yerahme’elite towns, for those in the Kenite towns,

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחָרְמָה וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּבוֹר־עָשָׁן וְלַאֲשֶׁר בַּעֲתָךְ׃
verses.english: for those in Horma, for those in Bekhor-Ashan, for those in Atakh,

verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וּלְכָל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלֶּךְ־שָׁם דָּוִד הוּא וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃
verses.english: for those in Hevron,and for all the places that David went around in, he and his men.

verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים נִלְחָמִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃
verses.english: Now the Philistines were waging battle against Israel,and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines;the slain fell on Mount Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּדְבְּקוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וַיַּכּוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁוּעַ בְּנֵי שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: And the Philistines caught up with) mean “stick to, cling to.” Sha’ul and with his sons,and the Philistines struck down Yehonatan and Avinadav and Malki-Shua, Sha’ul’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְבַּד הַמִּלְחָמָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ הַמּוֹרִים אֲנָשִׁים בַּקָּשֶׁת וַיָּחֶל מְאֹד מֵהַמּוֹרִים׃
verses.english: The battle was heavy around Sha’ul;the shooters, the men of the bow, found him,and he was seriously wounded by the shooters.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁאוּל לְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וְדָקְרֵנִי בָהּ פֶּן־יָבוֹאוּ הָעֲרֵלִים הָאֵלֶּה וּדְקָרֻנִי וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־בִי וְלֹא אָבָה נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו כִּי יָרֵא מְאֹד וַיִּקַּח שָׁאוּל אֶת־הַחֶרֶב וַיִּפֹּל עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: So Sha’ul said to his weapons bearer:Draw your sword and run me through with it,lest these Foreskinned Ones come and run me through and deal wantonly with me!But the weapons bearer would not, because he was exceedingly afraid,so Sha’ul took the sword and fell on it.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא נֹשֵׂא־כֵלָיו כִּי מֵת שָׁאוּל וַיִּפֹּל גַּם־הוּא עַל־חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּמָת עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: And his weapons bearer saw that Sha’ul was dead,so he too fell on his sword, and died with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו וְנֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו גַּם כָּל־אֲנָשָׁיו בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יַחְדָּו׃
verses.english: Thus died Sha’ul, and his three sons and his weapons bearer,indeed, all his men, on that day, together.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־בְּעֵבֶר הָעֵמֶק וַאֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן כִּי־נָסוּ אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי־מֵתוּ שָׁאוּל וּבָנָיו וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־הֶעָרִים וַיָּנֻסוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בָּהֶן׃
verses.english: The men of Israel saw, those across the Valley and those across the Jordan,that the [other] men of Israel had fled,and that Sha’ul and his sons had died,so they abandoned the towns and fled,and Philistines came and settled in them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמָּחֳרָת וַיָּבֹאוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְפַשֵּׁט אֶת־הַחֲלָלִים וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת בָּנָיו נֹפְלִים בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ׃
verses.english: Now it was on the morrow,that the Philistines came to strip the slain,and they found Sha’ul and his three sons, fallen on Mount Gilboa.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ בְאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּים סָבִיב לְבַשֵּׂר בֵּית עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וְאֶת־הָעָם׃
verses.english: They cut off his head and stripped off his armor,and sent [word] throughout the land of the Philistines, all around,to bring-the-news into the house of their carved-idols and among the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂמוּ אֶת־כֵּלָיו בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־גְּוִיָּתוֹ תָּקְעוּ בְּחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן׃
verses.english: They placed his armor in the Temple-House of Ashtarot).,and his corpse they thrust into the wall of Bet-She’an.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לְשָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: But the settled-folk of Yavesh-Gil’ad heardabout what the Philistines had done to Sha’ul,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ כָּל־אִישׁ חַיִל וַיֵּלְכוּ כָל־הַלַּיְלָה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־גְּוִיַּת שָׁאוּל וְאֵת גְּוִיֹּת בָּנָיו מֵחוֹמַת בֵּית שָׁן וַיָּבֹאוּ יָבֵשָׁה וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אֹתָם שָׁם׃
verses.english: so all the men of valor arose and went all nightand took down Sha’ul’s corpse and the corpses of his sons from the wall of Bet-Shan,and brought them to Yavesh, and burned them there;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְבְּרוּ תַחַת־הָאֶשֶׁל בְּיָבֵשָׁה וַיָּצֻמוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃
verses.english: then they took their bones and buried them beneath the tamarisk in Yavesh,and fasted for seven days.
